strings.scene.sanguo.dongzhuo.title: 连环计
strings.scene.sanguo.dongzhuo.subtitle: 诛董卓
strings.vo.01: 董卓迁都长安，自为太师，专权暴虐。吕布骁勇，卓爱信之，誓为父子。
strings.vo.02: 卓性刚褊，曾因小事拔手戟掷布，吕布避开了。布又与卓的侍婢私通，心中不安。
strings.vo.03: 司徒王允与仆射士孙瑞密谋诛卓，把计划告诉吕布。吕布说：奈如父子何？王允说：君自姓吕，本非骨肉。
strings.vo.04: 初平三年四月，献帝疾愈，大会未央殿。董卓朝服乘车而入。
strings.scene.sanguo.dongzhuo.fork.prompt: 连环计——依《三国志》直书，还是听演义「貂蝉」？
strings.scene.sanguo.dongzhuo.pick.canon: 正史 · 《三国志》《后汉书》所载
strings.scene.sanguo.dongzhuo.canon.intro: 北掖门内，十几个穿着卫士衣服的人站得笔直。为首的骑都尉李肃握紧了戟。
strings.scene.sanguo.dongzhuo.end.canon: 吕布应声持矛刺卓，趣兵斩之。长安士女卖珠玉衣装市酒肉相庆。然而王允不赦凉州诸将，两个月后李傕、郭汜攻破长安，王允被杀，吕布出走。
strings.scene.sanguo.dongzhuo.legend.disclaimer: 以下按《三国演义》第八、九回改编。貂蝉是小说人物：正史只说吕布与卓侍婢私通，未载其名。
strings.scene.sanguo.dongzhuo.legend.intro: 演义说：王允家中有歌伎貂蝉。王允先许嫁吕布，又献给董卓，离间父子，终使吕布刺卓。
strings.scene.sanguo.dongzhuo.end.legend: 吕布与董卓反目。演义汇回正史：北掖门刺卓。
strings.scene.sanguo.dongzhuo.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若王允赦免凉州诸将（未开放）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

narration: 董卓迁都长安，自为太师，专权暴虐。吕布骁勇，卓爱信之，誓为父子。
卓性刚褊，曾因小事拔手戟掷布，吕布避开了。布又与卓的侍婢私通，心中不安。
司徒王允与仆射士孙瑞密谋诛卓，把计划告诉吕布。吕布说：奈如父子何？王允说：君自姓吕，本非骨肉。
初平三年四月，献帝疾愈，大会未央殿。董卓朝服乘车而入。
车到北掖门——
吕布应声持矛刺卓，趣兵斩之。长安士女卖珠玉衣装市酒肉相庆。然而王允不赦凉州诸将，两个月后李傕、郭汜攻破长安，王允被杀，吕布出走。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Three Kingdoms (220–280) · The Chain Stratagem: Killing Dong Zhuo (「连环计」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 63 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Setting: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 192 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

Characters:
- Wang Yun (王允) — minister, Donghan; long robes, cloth headscarves; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Lü Bu (吕布) — general, Donghan; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Dong Zhuo (董卓) — minister, Donghan; long robes, cloth headscarves; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Li Su (李肃) — general, Donghan; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Shi Sunrui (士孙瑞) — minister, Donghan; long robes, cloth headscarves; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Li Jue (李傕) — general, Donghan; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains, clouds; midground: palace pillars, palace eaves | Action: Weiyang Palace in Chang'an, the emperor just recovered | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; clouds as moving pale wash | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「连环计」 with vermilion seal 「连环计」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「董卓迁都长安，自为太师，专权暴虐。吕布骁勇，卓爱信之，誓为父子。」
Shot 2 (8–17 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Dong Zhuo, Lü Bu, spear | Action: Dong Zhuo loses his temper and hurls a halberd at Lü Bu | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: ringing blade | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「卓性刚褊，曾因小事拔手戟掷布，吕布避开了。布又与卓的侍婢私通，心中不安。」
Shot 3 (17–28 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: moon; midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Wang Yun, Lü Bu | Action: Wang Yun meets Lü Bu in secret | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; moon left blank with pale wash around it | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「有诏讨贼臣」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「司徒王允与仆射士孙瑞密谋诛卓，把计划告诉吕布。吕布说：奈如父子何？王允说：君自姓吕，本非骨肉。」
Shot 4 (28–36 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: gate; subject: Li Su, crowd | Action: Li Su and a dozen men in guard uniforms wait at the north gate | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「初平三年四月，献帝疾愈，大会未央殿。董卓朝服乘车而入。」
Shot 5 (36–42 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: gate; subject: spear; dry-brush calligraphy 「北掖门」 | Action: By imperial edict, strike the traitor | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; a cold metallic glint on the blade; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: roaring crowd; SFX: ringing blade | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「车到北掖门——」
Shot 6 (42–57 s, 15 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Lü Bu spears Dong Zhuo and Chang'an celebrates, but two months later Li Jue and Guo Si take the city and Wang Yun is killed. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「吕布应声持矛刺卓，趣兵斩之。长安士女卖珠玉衣装市酒肉相庆。然而王允不赦凉州诸将，两个月后李傕、郭汜攻破长安，王允被杀，吕布出走。」
Shot 7 (57–63 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「有诏讨贼臣」 signed 《三国志·魏书·吕布传》; vermilion seal 「连环计」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「有诏讨贼臣」

Sound: Music: war drums and horns, heroic, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: palace hall reverb, night wind, wind over open plains, roaring crowd; SFX: ringing blade, footsteps; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「连环计」, subtitle 「诛董卓」, vermilion seal 「连环计」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「有诏讨贼臣」 — 《三国志·魏书·吕布传》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, detailed faces, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes

strings.scene.sanguo.zhujiu.title: 煮酒论英雄
strings.scene.sanguo.zhujiu.subtitle: 天下英雄
strings.vo.01: 刘备被吕布打败后投奔曹操，住在许都。车骑将军董承说自己接到献帝藏在衣带中的密诏，约他共诛曹操。刘备答应了，却还没有动手。
strings.vo.02: 一天，曹操从容地请刘备一起饮酒。
strings.vo.03: 他们谈起天下的豪杰。在曹操嘴里，袁绍、袁术这些人都不值一提。
strings.vo.04: 曹操说：今天下英雄，唯使君与操耳。本初之徒，不足数也。
strings.vo.05: 刘备正在吃饭，手里的匙和筷子掉在了地上——
strings.scene.sanguo.zhujiu.quote: 今天下英雄，唯使君与操耳。本初之徒，不足数也。
strings.scene.sanguo.zhujiu.fork.prompt: 煮酒论英雄——依《三国志》直书，还是听演义《三国演义》？
strings.anchor.yidaizhao: 董承称受献帝衣带中密诏，约刘备共诛曹操
strings.anchor.zhanchezhou: 刘备借截击袁术出许都，杀徐州刺史车胄
strings.scene.sanguo.zhujiu.canon.intro: 一顿酒，一句话，两个人都知道了对方是谁。刘备手里的筷子，掉在了地上。
strings.scene.sanguo.zhujiu.end.canon: 《华阳国志》说，当时恰好雷声大作，刘备说：圣人说迅雷风烈必变，真是这样。不久，他借截击袁术离开许都，到徐州杀了刺史车胄。衣带诏事泄，董承等人都被曹操诛杀。
strings.scene.sanguo.zhujiu.legend.disclaimer: 以下取明代小说《三国演义》第二十一回“曹操煮酒论英雄”：小说添了青梅煮酒、龙之变化的长篇议论与“学圃”的细节，惊雷的说法则本于《华阳国志》。
strings.scene.sanguo.zhujiu.legend.intro: 演义里，曹操指着天上的龙挂，说龙能大能小，能升能隐，可比世之英雄。
strings.scene.sanguo.zhujiu.end.legend: 演义里关张持剑闯入，见无事，才说是来舞剑助兴。曹操笑道：这又不是鸿门会。刘备从此决意离开许都。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 三国 · 东汉建安四年（约 199 年）。城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。
setting.en: Three Kingdoms (220–280), c. 199 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

characters.name: 曹操
characters.zh: 曹操（曹·司空）：袍服，幅巾或纶巾；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；“今天下英雄，唯使君与操耳”
characters.en: Cao Cao (曹操) — ruler, Cao; long robes, cloth headscarves; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 刘备
characters.zh: 刘备（刘·左将军）：袍服，幅巾或纶巾，筒袖铠，环首刀与长戟；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；闻言失匕箸，借雷声掩饰
characters.en: Liu Bei (刘备) — ruler, Liu; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 董承
characters.zh: 董承（东汉·车骑将军，献帝舅）：袍服，幅巾或纶巾，筒袖铠，环首刀与长戟；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；称受衣带诏，约刘备诛曹
characters.en: Dong Cheng (董承) — minister, Donghan; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 刘备被吕布打败后投奔曹操，住在许都。车骑将军董承说自己接到献帝藏在衣带中的密诏，约他共诛曹操。刘备答应了，却还没有动手。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–14 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：殿柱、近山与地面、屋檐；主体：刘备｜动作：许都后园，一个人弯着腰在菜畦里浇水｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：低风；音效：滴水｜屏幕文字：片名「煮酒论英雄」竖排书法与朱印「英雄」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「刘备被吕布打败后投奔曹操，住在许都。车骑将军董承说自己接到献帝藏在衣带中的密诏，约他共诛曹操。刘备答应了，却还没有动手。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–14 s, 14 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, near hills and ground, palace eaves; subject: Liu Bei | Action: In a back garden in Xu a man bends over a vegetable bed, watering | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: dripping water | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「煮酒论英雄」 with vermilion seal 「英雄」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「刘备被吕布打败后投奔曹操，住在许都。车骑将军董承说自己接到献帝藏在衣带中的密诏，约他共诛曹操。刘备答应了，却还没有动手。」

shots.vo: 一天，曹操从容地请刘备一起饮酒。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（14–20 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：曹操、刘备｜动作：亭中摆着青梅与一壶酒，司空请他入座｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：碰杯｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「一天，曹操从容地请刘备一起饮酒。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (14–20 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Cao Cao, Liu Bei | Action: In a pavilion green plums and a pot of wine are set out, and the Minister of Works invites him to sit | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: clinking cups | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「一天，曹操从容地请刘备一起饮酒。」

shots.vo: 他们谈起天下的豪杰。在曹操嘴里，袁绍、袁术这些人都不值一提。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（20–28 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：远景：云；中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：曹操｜动作：曹操一个一个数过去：袁术、袁绍、刘表、孙策，都不算｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；云气以淡墨晕染流动｜声音：环境：低风；音效：静默｜屏幕文字：引文「今天下英雄，唯使君与操耳。本初之徒，不足数也。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他们谈起天下的豪杰。在曹操嘴里，袁绍、袁术这些人都不值一提。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (20–28 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: background: clouds; midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Cao Cao | Action: Cao Cao counts them off one by one: Yuan Shu, Yuan Shao, Liu Biao, Sun Ce — none of them count | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; clouds as moving pale wash | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: silence | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「今天下英雄，唯使君与操耳。本初之徒，不足数也。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他们谈起天下的豪杰。在曹操嘴里，袁绍、袁术这些人都不值一提。」

shots.vo: 曹操说：今天下英雄，唯使君与操耳。本初之徒，不足数也。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（28–35 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：曹操｜动作：他看着刘备：今天下英雄，唯使君与操耳｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：静默｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「曹操说：今天下英雄，唯使君与操耳。本初之徒，不足数也。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (28–35 s, 7 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Cao Cao | Action: He looks at Liu Bei: the only heroes in the realm today are you and I | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: silence | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「曹操说：今天下英雄，唯使君与操耳。本初之徒，不足数也。」

shots.vo: 刘备正在吃饭，手里的匙和筷子掉在了地上——

narration: 刘备被吕布打败后投奔曹操，住在许都。车骑将军董承说自己接到献帝藏在衣带中的密诏，约他共诛曹操。刘备答应了，却还没有动手。
一天，曹操从容地请刘备一起饮酒。
他们谈起天下的豪杰。在曹操嘴里，袁绍、袁术这些人都不值一提。
曹操说：今天下英雄，唯使君与操耳。本初之徒，不足数也。
刘备正在吃饭，手里的匙和筷子掉在了地上——
《华阳国志》说，当时恰好雷声大作，刘备说：圣人说迅雷风烈必变，真是这样。不久，他借截击袁术离开许都，到徐州杀了刺史车胄。
今天下英雄，唯使君与操耳。本初之徒，不足数也。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Three Kingdoms (220–280) · Talking of Heroes over Wine: The Heroes of the Age (「煮酒论英雄」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 61 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Setting: Three Kingdoms (220–280), c. 199 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

Characters:
- Cao Cao (曹操) — ruler, Cao; long robes, cloth headscarves; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Liu Bei (刘备) — ruler, Liu; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

strings.scene.sanguo.guandu.title: 官渡之战
strings.scene.sanguo.guandu.subtitle: 夜袭乌巢
strings.vo.01: 建安五年，袁绍以十万之众南下，与曹操相持于官渡。
strings.vo.02: 数月之后，曹军粮少，士卒疲乏。曹操写信与荀彧，商议退守许都。
strings.vo.03: 荀彧回信劝他坚守。不久，袁绍谋士许攸来投。
strings.vo.04: 许攸说：袁军粮屯在乌巢，守备不严。曹操留曹洪守营，自率步骑五千，夜往乌巢。
strings.scene.sanguo.guandu.fork.prompt: 官渡之战——依《三国志》直书，还是听演义《三国演义》？
strings.scene.sanguo.guandu.canon.intro: 两军相持于官渡，曹军粮少，士卒疲乏。袁绍的谋士许攸夜里投奔曹营。
strings.scene.sanguo.guandu.end.canon: 乌巢粮尽，张郃、高览来降，袁军大溃。两年后，袁绍病死。
strings.scene.sanguo.guandu.legend.disclaimer: 以下取自明代小说《三国演义》第三十回，主干同正史，细节与对话为小说铺陈。
strings.scene.sanguo.guandu.legend.intro: 演义写许攸来投时，曹操跣足出迎，又问军粮几何，曹操先后几次虚报，被许攸一一识破。
strings.scene.sanguo.guandu.end.legend: 粮屯尽焚，袁军溃散。演义与正史同一结局。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 三国 · 建安五年（200 年）。城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。
setting.en: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 200 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

shots.vo: 建安五年，袁绍以十万之众南下，与曹操相持于官渡。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–7 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：河水、营帐｜动作：黄河之南，官渡营垒相望｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：旷野风声｜屏幕文字：片名「官渡之战」竖排书法与朱印「火烧乌巢」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「建安五年，袁绍以十万之众南下，与曹操相持于官渡。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–7 s, 7 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: river, army tents | Action: South of the Yellow River the ramparts at Guandu face each other | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「官渡之战」 with vermilion seal 「火烧乌巢」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「建安五年，袁绍以十万之众南下，与曹操相持于官渡。」

shots.vo: 数月之后，曹军粮少，士卒疲乏。曹操写信与荀彧，商议退守许都。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（7–15 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：卷轴；主体：曹操、盾墙｜动作：相持数月，曹军粮少｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：环境：军营鼓声；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「数月之后，曹军粮少，士卒疲乏。曹操写信与荀彧，商议退守许都。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (7–15 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: scroll; subject: Cao Cao, shield wall | Action: Months of stalemate; Cao's grain runs low | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「数月之后，曹军粮少，士卒疲乏。曹操写信与荀彧，商议退守许都。」

shots.vo: 荀彧回信劝他坚守。不久，袁绍谋士许攸来投。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（15–21 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：远景：月；主体：许攸、曹操｜动作：许攸夜投曹营｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；月轮留白，四周淡墨烘染｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「荀彧回信劝他坚守。不久，袁绍谋士许攸来投。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (15–21 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: background: moon; subject: Xu You, Cao Cao | Action: Xu You defects to Cao's camp at night | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; moon left blank with pale wash around it | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「荀彧回信劝他坚守。不久，袁绍谋士许攸来投。」

shots.vo: 许攸说：袁军粮屯在乌巢，守备不严。曹操留曹洪守营，自率步骑五千，夜往乌巢。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（21–30 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：远景：月；中景：烟；主体：骑兵｜动作：五千步骑，人持束薪，夜行｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；月轮留白，四周淡墨烘染；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「许攸说：袁军粮屯在乌巢，守备不严。曹操留曹洪守营，自率步骑五千，夜往乌巢。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (21–30 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: moon; midground: smoke; subject: cavalry | Action: Five thousand men, each with a bundle of firewood, march by night | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; ink spatters where hooves strike; moon left blank with pale wash around it; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「许攸说：袁军粮屯在乌巢，守备不严。曹操留曹洪守营，自率步骑五千，夜往乌巢。」

shots.vo: 火起——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（30–36 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：主体：火；飞白题字「乌巢之火」｜动作：乌巢火起｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；平涂黑焰剪影，焰心一抹朱红；四角暗角收拢；热浪与烟气扭曲；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：火声；音效：烈火｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「火起——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (30–36 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: subject: fire (splashed ink); dry-brush calligraphy 「乌巢之火」 | Action: Fire at Wuchao | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; flat black flame silhouettes with a single vermilion core; vignette closing in from the corners; heat-haze and smoke distortion; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: fire; SFX: roaring fire | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「火起——」

shots.vo: 乌巢粮尽，张郃、高览来降，袁军大溃。两年后，袁绍病死。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（36–43 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：乌巢粮尽，张郃、高览来降，袁军大溃。两年后，袁绍病死。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「乌巢粮尽，张郃、高览来降，袁军大溃。两年后，袁绍病死。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (36–43 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: The Wuchao stores burn, Zhang He defects and Yuan's army collapses; Yuan Shao dies two years later. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「乌巢粮尽，张郃、高览来降，袁军大溃。两年后，袁绍病死。」

shots.zh: 镜头 7（43–49 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文；右下角朱印「火烧乌巢」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处
shots.en: Shot 7 (43–49 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「火烧乌巢」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

sound.zh: 背景乐：战鼓与号角，雄壮，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、军营鼓声、夜风、火声；音效：竹简翻动、脚步声、马蹄声、烈火；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: war drums and horns, heroic, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, camp drums, night wind, fire; SFX: bamboo slips rustling, footsteps, hoofbeats, roaring fire; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 片头：右上竖排书法片名「官渡之战」，副题「夜袭乌巢」，朱印「火烧乌巢」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。
onScreenText.en: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「官渡之战」, subtitle 「夜袭乌巢」, vermilion seal 「火烧乌巢」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

narration: 建安五年，袁绍以十万之众南下，与曹操相持于官渡。
数月之后，曹军粮少，士卒疲乏。曹操写信与荀彧，商议退守许都。
荀彧回信劝他坚守。不久，袁绍谋士许攸来投。
许攸说：袁军粮屯在乌巢，守备不严。曹操留曹洪守营，自率步骑五千，夜往乌巢。
火起——
乌巢粮尽，张郃、高览来降，袁军大溃。两年后，袁绍病死。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Three Kingdoms (220–280) · The Battle of Guandu: Night Raid on Wuchao (「官渡之战」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 49 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Setting: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 200 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

Characters:
- Cao Cao (曹操) — ruler, Cao; long robes, cloth headscarves; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Xu You (许攸) — minister, Yuan; long robes, cloth headscarves; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Yuan Shao (袁绍) — ruler, Yuan; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Chun Yuqiong (淳于琼) — general, Yuan; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zhang He (张郃) — general, Yuan; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Xun Yu (荀彧) — minister, Cao; long robes, cloth headscarves; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–7 s, 7 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: river, army tents | Action: South of the Yellow River the ramparts at Guandu face each other | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「官渡之战」 with vermilion seal 「火烧乌巢」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「建安五年，袁绍以十万之众南下，与曹操相持于官渡。」
Shot 2 (7–15 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: scroll; subject: Cao Cao, shield wall | Action: Months of stalemate; Cao's grain runs low | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「数月之后，曹军粮少，士卒疲乏。曹操写信与荀彧，商议退守许都。」
Shot 3 (15–21 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: background: moon; subject: Xu You, Cao Cao | Action: Xu You defects to Cao's camp at night | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; moon left blank with pale wash around it | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「荀彧回信劝他坚守。不久，袁绍谋士许攸来投。」
Shot 4 (21–30 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: moon; midground: smoke; subject: cavalry | Action: Five thousand men, each with a bundle of firewood, march by night | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; ink spatters where hooves strike; moon left blank with pale wash around it; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「许攸说：袁军粮屯在乌巢，守备不严。曹操留曹洪守营，自率步骑五千，夜往乌巢。」
Shot 5 (30–36 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: subject: fire (splashed ink); dry-brush calligraphy 「乌巢之火」 | Action: Fire at Wuchao | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; flat black flame silhouettes with a single vermilion core; vignette closing in from the corners; heat-haze and smoke distortion; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: fire; SFX: roaring fire | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「火起——」
Shot 6 (36–43 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: The Wuchao stores burn, Zhang He defects and Yuan's army collapses; Yuan Shao dies two years later. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「乌巢粮尽，张郃、高览来降，袁军大溃。两年后，袁绍病死。」
Shot 7 (43–49 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「火烧乌巢」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

Sound: Music: war drums and horns, heroic, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, camp drums, night wind, fire; SFX: bamboo slips rustling, footsteps, hoofbeats, roaring fire; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「官渡之战」, subtitle 「夜袭乌巢」, vermilion seal 「火烧乌巢」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, detailed faces, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes

strings.scene.sanguo.baima.title: 万众斩颜良
strings.scene.sanguo.baima.subtitle: 关羽辞曹
strings.vo.01: 建安五年，袁绍派大将颜良围攻白马。曹操亲自北上救援，让张辽和刚刚归降的关羽打前锋。
strings.vo.02: 关羽望见颜良的麾盖，策马冲了过去。
strings.vo.03: 他在万众之中刺倒颜良，砍下首级回营，袁军诸将没有一个能挡住他。白马之围就此解除。
strings.vo.04: 曹操早就看出关羽没有久留之意，让张辽去问。关羽说：我深受曹公厚恩，但刘将军待我恩若兄弟，誓以共死，不可背之。我终究要走，要先立功报答曹公再走。
strings.vo.05: 斩了颜良之后，关羽把曹操的赏赐全部封存，留下书信告辞，去袁军中投奔刘备——
strings.scene.sanguo.baima.quote: 羽望见良麾盖，策马刺良于万众之中，斩其首还，绍诸将莫能当者。
strings.scene.sanguo.baima.fork.prompt: 万众斩颜良——依《三国志》直书，还是听演义《三国演义》？
strings.anchor.qinguanyu: 曹操东征，擒关羽，拜为偏将军
strings.anchor.cicao: 关羽尽封所赐，拜书告辞，奔刘备于袁军
strings.scene.sanguo.baima.canon.intro: 一个降将，在万军之中斩了敌方主将。他用这份功劳，向收留他的人告别。
strings.scene.sanguo.baima.end.canon: 曹操左右要去追，曹操说：彼各为其主，勿追也。关羽回到刘备身边。曹操封他的汉寿亭侯，他也一直沿用。
strings.scene.sanguo.baima.legend.disclaimer: 以下取明代小说《三国演义》第二十七回“美髯公千里走单骑 汉寿侯五关斩六将”：护送二嫂、连过五关、斩六员守将，是小说的创作，正史无载，路线地理也多有不合。
strings.scene.sanguo.baima.legend.intro: 演义里，关羽护着两位嫂嫂的车子，一路向北。前面是第一道关隘，东岭关。
strings.scene.sanguo.baima.end.legend: 演义里关羽斩了孔秀、韩福、孟坦、卞喜、王植、秦琪六员守将，终于在古城与刘备、张飞重逢。千里走单骑从此成了关羽忠义的象征。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 三国 · 建安五年（200 年四月）。城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。
setting.en: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 200 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

characters.name: 关羽
characters.zh: 关羽（刘·偏将军）：袍服，幅巾或纶巾，筒袖铠，环首刀与长戟；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；万众之中刺颜良，斩其首还
characters.en: Guan Yu (关羽) — general, Liu; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 建安五年，袁绍派大将颜良围攻白马。曹操亲自北上救援，让张辽和刚刚归降的关羽打前锋。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–11 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：远景：远山；中景：营帐；主体：颜良、旌旗、军阵、长兵如林｜动作：白马城外，袁军营垒连绵，中间竖着一顶大将的麾盖｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远｜声音：环境：军营鼓声；音效：战鼓｜屏幕文字：片名「万众斩颜良」竖排书法与朱印「斩颜良」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「建安五年，袁绍派大将颜良围攻白马。曹操亲自北上救援，让张辽和刚刚归降的关羽打前锋。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–11 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: army tents; subject: Yan Liang, banners, army ranks, forest of spears | Action: Outside Baima the Yuan camps stretch on, a general's canopy raised in their midst | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: war drums | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「万众斩颜良」 with vermilion seal 「斩颜良」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「建安五年，袁绍派大将颜良围攻白马。曹操亲自北上救援，让张辽和刚刚归降的关羽打前锋。」

shots.vo: 关羽望见颜良的麾盖，策马冲了过去。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（11–17 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：手持式轻微震动，节奏急促｜构图：主体：关羽、军阵、长兵如林、战马、大刀｜动作：一骑黑影从曹军阵中冲出，青龙长刀斜拖在地｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；枯笔竖线密如森林；兵刃金属寒光一闪｜声音：环境：battle-wind；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「关羽望见颜良的麾盖，策马冲了过去。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (11–17 s, 6 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: subject: Guan Yu, army ranks, forest of spears, war horse, broadsword | Action: A lone rider bursts from Cao's lines, a long blade trailing low | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: battle wind; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「关羽望见颜良的麾盖，策马冲了过去。」

shots.vo: 他在万众之中刺倒颜良，砍下首级回营，袁军诸将没有一个能挡住他。白马之围就此解除。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（17–27 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：主体：关羽、颜良、军阵、长兵如林、旌旗、大刀｜动作：万军之中，刀光一闪，麾盖倒下｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；枯笔竖线密如森林；兵刃金属寒光一闪；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：battle-roar；音效：刀声｜屏幕文字：引文「羽望见良麾盖，策马刺良于万众之中，斩其首还，绍诸将莫能当者。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他在万众之中刺倒颜良，砍下首级回营，袁军诸将没有一个能挡住他。白马之围就此解除。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (17–27 s, 10 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: subject: Guan Yu, Yan Liang, army ranks, forest of spears, banners, broadsword | Action: Amid ten thousand soldiers a blade flashes and the canopy falls | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears; a cold metallic glint on the blade; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: battle roar; SFX: blade | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「羽望见良麾盖，策马刺良于万众之中，斩其首还，绍诸将莫能当者。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他在万众之中刺倒颜良，砍下首级回营，袁军诸将没有一个能挡住他。白马之围就此解除。」

narration: 建安五年，袁绍派大将颜良围攻白马。曹操亲自北上救援，让张辽和刚刚归降的关羽打前锋。
关羽望见颜良的麾盖，策马冲了过去。
他在万众之中刺倒颜良，砍下首级回营，袁军诸将没有一个能挡住他。白马之围就此解除。
曹操早就看出关羽没有久留之意，让张辽去问。关羽说：我深受曹公厚恩，但刘将军待我恩若兄弟，誓以共死，不可背之。我终究要走，要先立功报答曹公再走。
斩了颜良之后，关羽把曹操的赏赐全部封存，留下书信告辞，去袁军中投奔刘备——
曹操左右要去追，曹操说：彼各为其主，勿追也。关羽回到刘备身边。曹操封他的汉寿亭侯，他也一直沿用。
羽望见良麾盖，策马刺良于万众之中，斩其首还，绍诸将莫能当者。

[Ink-wash video prompt] Three Kingdoms (220–280) · Beheading Yan Liang amid Ten Thousand: Guan Yu Leaves Cao (「万众斩颜良」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 71 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Setting: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 200 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

Characters:
- Guan Yu (关羽) — general, Liu; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Yan Liang (颜良) — general, Yuan; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Cao Cao (曹操) — ruler, Cao; long robes, cloth headscarves; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zhang Liao (张辽) — general, Cao; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

strings.scene.sanguo.sunce.title: 小霸王之死
strings.scene.sanguo.sunce.subtitle: 孙策遇刺
strings.vo.01: 孙策用了几年时间，从袁术手下的一员小将，打下了整个江东。曹操与袁绍在官渡对峙时，他暗中准备北袭许都。
strings.vo.02: 孙策喜欢打猎，常常一个人驰马在前。一天在丹徒西山，他遇到三个人。这三人是被他杀死的吴郡太守许贡的门客。
strings.vo.03: 他们张弓就射，一箭射中了孙策的面颊。
strings.vo.04: 孙策伤重，叫来张昭等人，把印绶交给弟弟孙权，说：举江东之众，决机于两阵之间，与天下争衡，卿不如我；举贤任能，各尽其心，以保江东，我不如卿。
strings.vo.05: 当天夜里，孙策去世，年仅二十六岁——
strings.scene.sanguo.sunce.quote: 举贤任能，各尽其心，以保江东，我不如卿。
strings.scene.sanguo.sunce.fork.prompt: 小霸王之死——依《三国志》直书，还是听志怪《搜神记》？
strings.anchor.chulie: 孙策单骑出猎丹徒西山
strings.anchor.quanji: 孙策临终以印绶付孙权，张昭辅政
strings.scene.sanguo.sunce.canon.intro: 二十六岁的孙策打下了江东，却死在一次打猎中。他把江东交给了十九岁的弟弟。
strings.scene.sanguo.sunce.end.canon: 孙权继位，张昭率群僚辅佐，周瑜从巴丘带兵赶来奔丧。孙权在江东经营了五十多年，后来称帝，建立吴国。
strings.scene.sanguo.sunce.legend.disclaimer: 以下取东晋干宝《搜神记》卷一与《三国志》裴注引《江表传》所载于吉之事：孙策杀道士于吉，后来照镜时常见于吉在镜中，伤口崩裂而死。属志怪附会，裴松之已指出年代不合。
strings.scene.sanguo.sunce.legend.intro: 搜神记里说，孙策要渡江袭许，军中却有许多人在拜一个叫于吉的道士。
strings.scene.sanguo.sunce.end.legend: 故事说孙策拍镜大叫，伤口崩裂而死。裴松之认为，于吉之事与孙策的经历年代不合，大约是后人附会的。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 三国 · 建安五年（200 年四月）。城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。
setting.en: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 200 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

shots.vo: 孙策用了几年时间，从袁术手下的一员小将，打下了整个江东。曹操与袁绍在官渡对峙时，他暗中准备北袭许都。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–12 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：树、树冠、近山与地面；主体：孙策、战马｜动作：丹徒西山，一匹快马把随从远远甩在后面｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：forest-wind；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：片名「小霸王之死」竖排书法与朱印「江东」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「孙策用了几年时间，从袁术手下的一员小将，打下了整个江东。曹操与袁绍在官渡对峙时，他暗中准备北袭许都。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–12 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: trees, tree canopy, near hills and ground; subject: Sun Ce, war horse | Action: In the western hills of Dantu a swift horse leaves the escort far behind | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: forest wind; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「小霸王之死」 with vermilion seal 「江东」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孙策用了几年时间，从袁术手下的一员小将，打下了整个江东。曹操与袁绍在官渡对峙时，他暗中准备北袭许都。」

shots.vo: 孙策喜欢打猎，常常一个人驰马在前。一天在丹徒西山，他遇到三个人。这三人是被他杀死的吴郡太守许贡的门客。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（12–25 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：树、树冠；主体：许贡门客、弓箭｜动作：林中三个人影站起，手里拿着弓｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：forest-wind；音效：静默｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「孙策喜欢打猎，常常一个人驰马在前。一天在丹徒西山，他遇到三个人。这三人是被他杀死的吴郡太守许贡的门客。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (12–25 s, 13 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: trees, tree canopy; subject: Xu Gongmenke, bow | Action: Three figures rise in the woods holding bows | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: forest wind; SFX: silence | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孙策喜欢打猎，常常一个人驰马在前。一天在丹徒西山，他遇到三个人。这三人是被他杀死的吴郡太守许贡的门客。」

shots.vo: 他们张弓就射，一箭射中了孙策的面颊。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（25–31 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：手持式轻微震动，节奏急促｜构图：中景：树、树冠；主体：孙策、许贡门客、弓箭｜动作：一箭射中年轻将军的面颊｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入｜声音：环境：forest-wind；音效：箭矢破空｜屏幕文字：引文「举贤任能，各尽其心，以保江东，我不如卿。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他们张弓就射，一箭射中了孙策的面颊。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (25–31 s, 6 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: midground: trees, tree canopy; subject: Sun Ce, Xu Gongmenke, bow | Action: An arrow strikes the young general in the cheek | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter | Sound: ambience: forest wind; SFX: whistling arrow | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「举贤任能，各尽其心，以保江东，我不如卿。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他们张弓就射，一箭射中了孙策的面颊。」

shots.vo: 孙策伤重，叫来张昭等人，把印绶交给弟弟孙权，说：举江东之众，决机于两阵之间，与天下争衡，卿不如我；举贤任能，各尽其心，以保江东，我不如卿。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（31–46 秒，15 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：孙策、孙权｜动作：病榻前，他把印绶递给十九岁的弟弟｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「孙策伤重，叫来张昭等人，把印绶交给弟弟孙权，说：举江东之众，决机于两阵之间，与天下争衡，卿不如我；举贤任能，各尽其心，以保江东，我不如卿。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (31–46 s, 15 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Sun Ce, Sun Quan | Action: At his sickbed he hands the seal and ribbon to his nineteen-year-old brother | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孙策伤重，叫来张昭等人，把印绶交给弟弟孙权，说：举江东之众，决机于两阵之间，与天下争衡，卿不如我；举贤任能，各尽其心，以保江东，我不如卿。」

shots.vo: 当天夜里，孙策去世，年仅二十六岁——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（46–52 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：孙权、张昭；飞白题字「江东」｜动作：印绶交到孙权手中，屏风后一盏灯熄灭了｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：箭矢破空｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「当天夜里，孙策去世，年仅二十六岁——」

narration: 孙策用了几年时间，从袁术手下的一员小将，打下了整个江东。曹操与袁绍在官渡对峙时，他暗中准备北袭许都。
孙策喜欢打猎，常常一个人驰马在前。一天在丹徒西山，他遇到三个人。这三人是被他杀死的吴郡太守许贡的门客。
他们张弓就射，一箭射中了孙策的面颊。
孙策伤重，叫来张昭等人，把印绶交给弟弟孙权，说：举江东之众，决机于两阵之间，与天下争衡，卿不如我；举贤任能，各尽其心，以保江东，我不如卿。
当天夜里，孙策去世，年仅二十六岁——
孙权继位，张昭率群僚辅佐，周瑜从巴丘带兵赶来奔丧。孙权在江东经营了五十多年，后来称帝，建立吴国。
举贤任能，各尽其心，以保江东，我不如卿。

strings.scene.sanguo.caochong.title: 曹冲称象
strings.scene.sanguo.caochong.subtitle: 仓舒早慧
strings.vo.01: 孙权曾经送给曹操一头大象。曹操想知道它有多重，问遍了左右，没有人想得出办法。
strings.vo.02: 群臣说：除非造一杆大秤，或者把象杀了分开称。
strings.vo.03: 曹操的儿子曹冲当时只有五六岁，却说：把象放到大船上，刻下水痕所到之处。
strings.vo.04: 然后把象牵下来，往船上装东西，装到船沉到刻痕的位置。
strings.vo.05: 再把船上的东西称一称，就知道象有多重了——
strings.scene.sanguo.caochong.quote: 置象大船之上，而刻其水痕所至，称物以载之，则校可知矣。
strings.scene.sanguo.caochong.fork.prompt: 曹冲称象——依《三国志》直书，还是听佛经《杂宝藏经》？
strings.anchor.juxiang: 孙权送来一头大象，曹操想知道它有多重
strings.scene.sanguo.caochong.canon.intro: 一头大象，一条船，一道刻在船舷上的水痕。一个五六岁的孩子想出了所有大人都没想到的办法。
strings.scene.sanguo.caochong.end.canon: 曹操大喜，立即照办。曹冲生而聪慧，又仁爱，常为犯法的小吏求情。曹操几次在群臣面前称赞他，有意立他为嗣。可惜建安十三年他病死，年仅十三岁。曹操对曹丕说：此我之不幸，而汝曹之幸也。
strings.scene.sanguo.caochong.legend.disclaimer: 以下取北魏汉译佛经《杂宝藏经》卷一“弃老国缘”中的类似故事：天神问国王象有多重，一位被藏起来的老人教儿子用船称象。近人据此怀疑曹冲称象有借用佛经故事的成分，学界看法不一。
strings.scene.sanguo.caochong.legend.intro: 佛经里说，有一个国家的风俗是抛弃老人。一个大臣不忍，把父亲藏在了地窖里。
strings.scene.sanguo.caochong.end.legend: 佛经说国王得知答案出自老人，从此废除了抛弃老人的旧俗。同一个称象的办法，在两个故事里分别属于一个孩子和一位老人。
strings.scene.sanguo.caochong.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若曹冲不死（未开放）

画风：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）——大块黑色剪影与平涂灰阶，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白；少纹理、少装饰；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：2×2 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。
清单：
第 1 行：1. 泼墨墨点飞溅；2. 飞白笔触。
第 2 行：3. 船行尾迹；4. 留空。
排版参考尺寸：1024×1024 像素，每格按 512×512 切分；实际生成尺寸以所用服务返回值为准，裁切前须确认比例与透明通道。只有墨线与墨块，不加任何文字、书法、印章、边框、网格线、水印。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 三国 · 东汉建安中（约 205 年前后）。城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。
setting.en: Three Kingdoms (220–280), c. 205 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

characters.name: 曹冲
characters.zh: 曹冲（曹·字仓舒，曹操之子）：袍服，幅巾或纶巾；宗室贵胄华服，玉佩冠带；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；五六岁，以舟称象；年十三卒
characters.en: Cao Chong (曹冲) — royal / consort, Cao; long robes, cloth headscarves; noble prince's rich robes, jade pendants, formal cap and sash; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 曹操
characters.zh: 曹操（曹·司空）：袍服，幅巾或纶巾；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；欲知象重，问群下
characters.en: Cao Cao (曹操) — ruler, Cao; long robes, cloth headscarves; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 孙权曾经送给曹操一头大象。曹操想知道它有多重，问遍了左右，没有人想得出办法。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–10 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：众人｜动作：江东送来的巨象站在庭院里，比屋檐还高｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：人群低语；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：片名「曹冲称象」竖排书法与朱印「称象」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「孙权曾经送给曹操一头大象。曹操想知道它有多重，问遍了左右，没有人想得出办法。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: crowd | Action: The great elephant sent from the east stands in the courtyard, taller than the eaves | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「曹冲称象」 with vermilion seal 「称象」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孙权曾经送给曹操一头大象。曹操想知道它有多重，问遍了左右，没有人想得出办法。」

shots.vo: 群臣说：除非造一杆大秤，或者把象杀了分开称。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（10–17 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：曹操、众人｜动作：群臣围着它议论，谁也想不出称的办法｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：人群低语；音效：低语｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「群臣说：除非造一杆大秤，或者把象杀了分开称。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (10–17 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Cao Cao, crowd | Action: The ministers argue around it; none can think how to weigh it | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: murmuring | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「群臣说：除非造一杆大秤，或者把象杀了分开称。」

shots.vo: 曹操的儿子曹冲当时只有五六岁，却说：把象放到大船上，刻下水痕所到之处。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（17–26 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：曹冲、曹操｜动作：一个五六岁的孩子拉着父亲的衣袖说：我有办法｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：低风；音效：静默｜屏幕文字：引文「置象大船之上，而刻其水痕所至，称物以载之，则校可知矣。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「曹操的儿子曹冲当时只有五六岁，却说：把象放到大船上，刻下水痕所到之处。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (17–26 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Cao Chong, Cao Cao | Action: A child of five or six tugs his father's sleeve: I know a way | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: silence | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「置象大船之上，而刻其水痕所至，称物以载之，则校可知矣。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「曹操的儿子曹冲当时只有五六岁，却说：把象放到大船上，刻下水痕所到之处。」

shots.vo: 然后把象牵下来，往船上装东西，装到船沉到刻痕的位置。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（26–34 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：河水、舟；主体：曹冲、水｜动作：大象被牵上船，船身下沉，小孩在船舷上刻下一道水痕｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：平缓河水；音效：水花｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「然后把象牵下来，往船上装东西，装到船沉到刻痕的位置。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (26–34 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: river, boat; subject: Cao Chong, water | Action: The elephant is led onto a boat, the hull sinks, and the boy cuts a mark at the waterline | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: water splash | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「然后把象牵下来，往船上装东西，装到船沉到刻痕的位置。」

shots.vo: 再把船上的东西称一称，就知道象有多重了——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（34–40 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：河水、舟；主体：曹冲、水；飞白题字「称象」｜动作：象牵下来，换上一筐筐石头，船沉到同一道刻痕｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾；四角暗角收拢；水墨流动晕染；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：平缓河水；音效：水花｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「再把船上的东西称一称，就知道象有多重了——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (34–40 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: river, boat; subject: Cao Chong, water; dry-brush calligraphy 「称象」 | Action: The elephant is led off, baskets of stone are loaded until the boat sinks to the same mark | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; vignette closing in from the corners; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: water splash | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「再把船上的东西称一称，就知道象有多重了——」

shots.vo: 曹操大喜，立即照办。曹冲生而聪慧，又仁爱，常为犯法的小吏求情。曹操几次在群臣面前称赞他，有意立他为嗣。可惜建安十三年他病死，年仅十三岁。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（40–56 秒，16 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：曹冲｜动作：正史结局：曹操大喜，立即照办。曹冲生而聪慧，又仁爱，常为犯法的小吏求情。曹操几次在群臣面前称赞他，有意立他为嗣。可惜建安十三年他病死，年仅十三岁。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「曹操大喜，立即照办。曹冲生而聪慧，又仁爱，常为犯法的小吏求情。曹操几次在群臣面前称赞他，有意立他为嗣。可惜建安十三年他病死，年仅十三岁。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (40–56 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Cao Chong | Action: Canonical outcome: Cao Cao is delighted and does it at once; the kind and gifted boy dies at thirteen in 208, and Cao Cao tells Cao Pi: my misfortune is your good fortune. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「曹操大喜，立即照办。曹冲生而聪慧，又仁爱，常为犯法的小吏求情。曹操几次在群臣面前称赞他，有意立他为嗣。可惜建安十三年他病死，年仅十三岁。」

shots.vo: 置象大船之上，而刻其水痕所至，称物以载之，则校可知矣。
shots.zh: 镜头 7（56–62 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「置象大船之上，而刻其水痕所至，称物以载之，则校可知矣。」，下署《三国志·魏书·邓哀王冲传》；右下角朱印「称象」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「置象大船之上，而刻其水痕所至，称物以载之，则校可知矣。」
shots.en: Shot 7 (56–62 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「置象大船之上，而刻其水痕所至，称物以载之，则校可知矣。」 signed 《三国志·魏书·邓哀王冲传》; vermilion seal 「称象」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「置象大船之上，而刻其水痕所至，称物以载之，则校可知矣。」

sound.zh: 背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：人群低语、低风、平缓河水；音效：脚步声、低语、静默、水花；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: crowd murmur, low wind, calm river; SFX: footsteps, murmuring, silence, water splash; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 片头：右上竖排书法片名「曹冲称象」，副题「仓舒早慧」，朱印「称象」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；引文：「置象大船之上，而刻其水痕所至，称物以载之，则校可知矣。」——《三国志·魏书·邓哀王冲传》，竖排楷书；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。
onScreenText.en: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「曹冲称象」, subtitle 「仓舒早慧」, vermilion seal 「称象」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「置象大船之上，而刻其水痕所至，称物以载之，则校可知矣。」 — 《三国志·魏书·邓哀王冲传》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

narration: 孙权曾经送给曹操一头大象。曹操想知道它有多重，问遍了左右，没有人想得出办法。
群臣说：除非造一杆大秤，或者把象杀了分开称。
曹操的儿子曹冲当时只有五六岁，却说：把象放到大船上，刻下水痕所到之处。
然后把象牵下来，往船上装东西，装到船沉到刻痕的位置。
再把船上的东西称一称，就知道象有多重了——
曹操大喜，立即照办。曹冲生而聪慧，又仁爱，常为犯法的小吏求情。曹操几次在群臣面前称赞他，有意立他为嗣。可惜建安十三年他病死，年仅十三岁。
置象大船之上，而刻其水痕所至，称物以载之，则校可知矣。

prompt.zh:

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Three Kingdoms (220–280) · Cao Chong Weighs the Elephant: A Precocious Child (「曹冲称象」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 62 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Setting: Three Kingdoms (220–280), c. 205 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

Characters:
- Cao Chong (曹冲) — royal / consort, Cao; long robes, cloth headscarves; noble prince's rich robes, jade pendants, formal cap and sash; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Cao Cao (曹操) — ruler, Cao; long robes, cloth headscarves; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Cao Pi (曹丕) — royal / consort, Cao; long robes, cloth headscarves; noble prince's rich robes, jade pendants, formal cap and sash; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: crowd | Action: The great elephant sent from the east stands in the courtyard, taller than the eaves | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「曹冲称象」 with vermilion seal 「称象」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孙权曾经送给曹操一头大象。曹操想知道它有多重，问遍了左右，没有人想得出办法。」
Shot 2 (10–17 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Cao Cao, crowd | Action: The ministers argue around it; none can think how to weigh it | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: murmuring | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「群臣说：除非造一杆大秤，或者把象杀了分开称。」
Shot 3 (17–26 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Cao Chong, Cao Cao | Action: A child of five or six tugs his father's sleeve: I know a way | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: silence | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「置象大船之上，而刻其水痕所至，称物以载之，则校可知矣。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「曹操的儿子曹冲当时只有五六岁，却说：把象放到大船上，刻下水痕所到之处。」
Shot 4 (26–34 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: river, boat; subject: Cao Chong, water | Action: The elephant is led onto a boat, the hull sinks, and the boy cuts a mark at the waterline | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: water splash | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「然后把象牵下来，往船上装东西，装到船沉到刻痕的位置。」
Shot 5 (34–40 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: river, boat; subject: Cao Chong, water; dry-brush calligraphy 「称象」 | Action: The elephant is led off, baskets of stone are loaded until the boat sinks to the same mark | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; vignette closing in from the corners; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: water splash | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「再把船上的东西称一称，就知道象有多重了——」
Shot 6 (40–56 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Cao Chong | Action: Canonical outcome: Cao Cao is delighted and does it at once; the kind and gifted boy dies at thirteen in 208, and Cao Cao tells Cao Pi: my misfortune is your good fortune. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「曹操大喜，立即照办。曹冲生而聪慧，又仁爱，常为犯法的小吏求情。曹操几次在群臣面前称赞他，有意立他为嗣。可惜建安十三年他病死，年仅十三岁。」
Shot 7 (56–62 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「置象大船之上，而刻其水痕所至，称物以载之，则校可知矣。」 signed 《三国志·魏书·邓哀王冲传》; vermilion seal 「称象」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「置象大船之上，而刻其水痕所至，称物以载之，则校可知矣。」

Sound: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: crowd murmur, low wind, calm river; SFX: footsteps, murmuring, silence, water splash; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「曹冲称象」, subtitle 「仓舒早慧」, vermilion seal 「称象」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「置象大船之上，而刻其水痕所至，称物以载之，则校可知矣。」 — 《三国志·魏书·邓哀王冲传》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, detailed faces, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes

strings.scene.sanguo.longzhong.title: 三顾茅庐
strings.scene.sanguo.longzhong.subtitle: 隆中对
strings.vo.01: 刘备屯新野。徐庶对他说：诸葛孔明者，卧龙也，将军岂愿见之乎？
strings.vo.02: 刘备说：君与俱来。徐庶说：此人可就见，不可屈致也，将军宜枉驾顾之。
strings.vo.03: 刘备于是去隆中拜访，凡三往，乃见。
strings.vo.04: 他屏退左右，问：汉室倾颓，奸臣窃命，孤不度德量力，欲信大义于天下，计将安出？
strings.scene.sanguo.longzhong.quote: 先帝不以臣卑鄙，猥自枉屈，三顾臣于草庐之中
strings.scene.sanguo.longzhong.fork.prompt: 三顾茅庐——依《三国志》直书，还是听异说「亮先诣备」？
strings.scene.sanguo.longzhong.pick.canon: 正史 · 《三国志·诸葛亮传》所载
strings.scene.sanguo.longzhong.canon.intro: 隆中的草庐前，童子说先生出门去了。刘备在门外站了很久。
strings.scene.sanguo.longzhong.end.canon: 诸葛亮出山辅佐刘备。关、张乃止。“三分天下”的谋划，从此成为蜀汉的方略。
strings.scene.sanguo.longzhong.legend.disclaimer: 以下取自《三国志》裴注所引《魏略》《九州春秋》的异说：诸葛亮主动北行去见刘备，并非刘备三顾。裴松之认为此说与《出师表》不合，不可信。
strings.scene.sanguo.longzhong.legend.intro: 《魏略》说：刘备屯樊城时，诸葛亮北行见他。刘备起初并不在意，见众宾散去，亮独留，才与他深谈。
strings.scene.sanguo.longzhong.end.legend: 两种说法的结局相同：诸葛亮成为刘备的谋主。
strings.scene.sanguo.longzhong.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若诸葛亮不出山（未开放）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 三国 · 东汉建安十二年（207 年）。城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。
setting.en: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 207 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

shots.vo: 刘备屯新野。徐庶对他说：诸葛孔明者，卧龙也，将军岂愿见之乎？
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面；主体：竹｜动作：隆中山间，草庐一座｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；竹叶撇笔，风中摇动；竹简断裂、墨迹飞溅｜声音：环境：林中鸟鸣｜屏幕文字：片名「三顾茅庐」竖排书法与朱印「隆中对」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「刘备屯新野。徐庶对他说：诸葛孔明者，卧龙也，将军岂愿见之乎？」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground; subject: bamboo | Action: A thatched cottage in the Longzhong hills | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; flicked bamboo leaves swaying; bamboo slips snapping with ink spatter | Sound: ambience: forest birds | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「三顾茅庐」 with vermilion seal 「隆中对」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「刘备屯新野。徐庶对他说：诸葛孔明者，卧龙也，将军岂愿见之乎？」

shots.vo: 刘备说：君与俱来。徐庶说：此人可就见，不可屈致也，将军宜枉驾顾之。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（8–16 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：营帐；主体：徐庶、刘备｜动作：徐庶说：诸葛孔明者，卧龙也｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「刘备说：君与俱来。徐庶说：此人可就见，不可屈致也，将军宜枉驾顾之。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (8–16 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Xu Shu, Liu Bei | Action: Xu Shu says: Zhuge Kongming is a sleeping dragon | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「刘备说：君与俱来。徐庶说：此人可就见，不可屈致也，将军宜枉驾顾之。」

shots.vo: 刘备于是去隆中拜访，凡三往，乃见。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（16–22 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：近山与地面；主体：刘备；飞白题字「雪」｜动作：风雪中，再往不遇｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；留白为雪，枯笔点出雪片｜声音：环境：低风；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：引文「先帝不以臣卑鄙，猥自枉屈，三顾臣于草庐之中」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「刘备于是去隆中拜访，凡三往，乃见。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (16–22 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: near hills and ground; subject: Liu Bei; dry-brush calligraphy 「雪」 | Action: Through wind and snow, the second visit finds no one | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; blank paper as snow, dry-brush flakes | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「先帝不以臣卑鄙，猥自枉屈，三顾臣于草庐之中」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「刘备于是去隆中拜访，凡三往，乃见。」

narration: 刘备屯新野。徐庶对他说：诸葛孔明者，卧龙也，将军岂愿见之乎？
刘备说：君与俱来。徐庶说：此人可就见，不可屈致也，将军宜枉驾顾之。
刘备于是去隆中拜访，凡三往，乃见。
他屏退左右，问：汉室倾颓，奸臣窃命，孤不度德量力，欲信大义于天下，计将安出？
诸葛亮答——
诸葛亮出山辅佐刘备。关、张乃止。“三分天下”的谋划，从此成为蜀汉的方略。

strings.scene.sanguo.changban.title: 长坂坡
strings.scene.sanguo.changban.subtitle: 赵云与张飞
strings.vo.01: 刘表死，其子刘琮降曹。刘备南走，荆州百姓十余万、辎重数千两随行，日行十余里。
strings.vo.02: 曹操亲率精骑五千追赶，一日一夜行三百余里，及于当阳长坂。
strings.vo.03: 刘备弃妻子，与诸葛亮、张飞、赵云等数十骑逃走。
strings.vo.04: 赵云在乱军中身抱弱子，保护甘夫人，都得免难。
strings.scene.sanguo.changban.quote: 身是张益德也，可来共决死
strings.scene.sanguo.changban.fork.prompt: 长坂坡——依《三国志》直书，还是听演义「七进七出」？
strings.scene.sanguo.changban.canon.intro: 当阳长坂，人马与百姓混在一起。有人对刘备说：赵云已北走降曹了。刘备以手戟掷之：子龙不弃我走也。
strings.scene.sanguo.changban.end.canon: 曹兵无敢近者。刘备与关羽船队会于汉津，又与刘表长子刘琦合，同到夏口。此前鲁肃已在当阳与刘备相会，孙刘联合由此开始。
strings.scene.sanguo.changban.legend.disclaimer: 以下按《三国演义》第四十一、四十二回改编：赵云七进七出、怀抱阿斗杀出重围，糜夫人投井，张飞一声喝断桥梁，都是小说增饰。
strings.scene.sanguo.changban.legend.intro: 演义说：赵云单骑在曹军中往来冲杀，糜夫人把阿斗托付给他，自己投井而死。赵云解开勒甲绦，把阿斗揣在怀中，杀透重围。
strings.scene.sanguo.changban.end.legend: 赵云献上阿斗，刘备掷之于地。演义汇回正史：同奔夏口。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 三国 · 东汉建安十三年（208 年）。城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。
setting.en: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 208 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

characters.name: 赵云
characters.zh: 赵云（蜀·子龙）：袍服，幅巾或纶巾，筒袖铠，环首刀与长戟；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；身抱弱子，保护甘夫人，皆得免难
characters.en: Zhao Yun (赵云) — general, Shu; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.en: Zhang Fei (张飞) — general, Shu; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 曹操

characters.en: Lady Gan (甘夫人) — royal / consort, Shu; long robes, cloth headscarves; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 刘表死，其子刘琮降曹。刘备南走，荆州百姓十余万、辎重数千两随行，日行十余里。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–10 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：草；主体：众人｜动作：当阳长坂，百姓十余万随军南行｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：人群低语｜屏幕文字：片名「长坂坡」竖排书法与朱印「长坂」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「刘表死，其子刘琮降曹。刘备南走，荆州百姓十余万、辎重数千两随行，日行十余里。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: grass; subject: crowd | Action: At Changban near Dangyang a hundred thousand civilians follow the army south | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「长坂坡」 with vermilion seal 「长坂」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「刘表死，其子刘琮降曹。刘备南走，荆州百姓十余万、辎重数千两随行，日行十余里。」

shots.vo: 曹操亲率精骑五千追赶，一日一夜行三百余里，及于当阳长坂。
