shots.en: Shot 2 (10–18 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: smoke; subject: cavalry | Action: Cao's elite cavalry ride three hundred li in a day and night | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; ink spatters where hooves strike; pale ink smoke drifting sideways; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「曹操亲率精骑五千追赶，一日一夜行三百余里，及于当阳长坂。」

shots.vo: 刘备弃妻子，与诸葛亮、张飞、赵云等数十骑逃走。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（18–25 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：主体：赵云、军阵、长兵如林、战马｜动作：乱军中，赵云身抱弱子｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；枯笔竖线密如森林｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：兵刃相击｜屏幕文字：引文「身是张益德也，可来共决死」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「刘备弃妻子，与诸葛亮、张飞、赵云等数十骑逃走。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (18–25 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: subject: Zhao Yun, army ranks, forest of spears, war horse | Action: Zhao Yun carries the infant through the chaos | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: clashing weapons | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「身是张益德也，可来共决死」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「刘备弃妻子，与诸葛亮、张飞、赵云等数十骑逃走。」

shots.vo: 赵云在乱军中身抱弱子，保护甘夫人，都得免难。

shots.en: Shot 4 (25–32 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: river; subject: Zhang Fei, spear | Action: Zhang Fei holds the broken bridge, glaring, spear levelled | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: war cries | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「赵云在乱军中身抱弱子，保护甘夫人，都得免难。」

shots.vo: 张飞率二十骑断后——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（32–38 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：河水；主体：骑兵；飞白题字「断桥」｜动作：敌皆无敢近者｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；四角暗角收拢；水墨流动晕染；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：平缓河水；音效：喊杀｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「张飞率二十骑断后——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (32–38 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: river; subject: cavalry; dry-brush calligraphy 「断桥」 | Action: No enemy dares come near | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; ink spatters where hooves strike; vignette closing in from the corners; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: war cries | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「张飞率二十骑断后——」

shots.vo: 曹兵无敢近者。刘备与关羽船队会于汉津，又与刘表长子刘琦合，同到夏口。此前鲁肃已在当阳与刘备相会，孙刘联合由此开始。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（38–52 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：曹兵无敢近者。刘备与关羽船队会于汉津，又与刘表长子刘琦合，同到夏口。此前鲁肃已在当阳与刘备相会，孙刘联合由此开始。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「曹兵无敢近者。刘备与关羽船队会于汉津，又与刘表长子刘琦合，同到夏口。此前鲁肃已在当阳与刘备相会，孙刘联合由此开始。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (38–52 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Liu Bei joins Guan Yu's fleet and Liu Qi at Xiakou; having met Lu Su at Dangyang, the Sun–Liu alliance begins. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「曹兵无敢近者。刘备与关羽船队会于汉津，又与刘表长子刘琦合，同到夏口。此前鲁肃已在当阳与刘备相会，孙刘联合由此开始。」

shots.vo: 身是张益德也，可来共决死
shots.zh: 镜头 7（52–58 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「身是张益德也，可来共决死」，下署《三国志·蜀书·张飞传》；右下角朱印「长坂」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「身是张益德也，可来共决死」
shots.en: Shot 7 (52–58 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「身是张益德也，可来共决死」 signed 《三国志·蜀书·张飞传》; vermilion seal 「长坂」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「身是张益德也，可来共决死」

sound.zh: 背景乐：战鼓与号角，雄壮，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：人群低语、远处厮杀声、平缓河水；音效：马蹄声、兵刃相击、喊杀；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: war drums and horns, heroic, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: crowd murmur, distant battle, calm river; SFX: hoofbeats, clashing weapons, war cries; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 片头：右上竖排书法片名「长坂坡」，副题「赵云与张飞」，朱印「长坂」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；引文：「身是张益德也，可来共决死」——《三国志·蜀书·张飞传》，竖排楷书；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。
onScreenText.en: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「长坂坡」, subtitle 「赵云与张飞」, vermilion seal 「长坂」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「身是张益德也，可来共决死」 — 《三国志·蜀书·张飞传》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

narration: 刘表死，其子刘琮降曹。刘备南走，荆州百姓十余万、辎重数千两随行，日行十余里。
曹操亲率精骑五千追赶，一日一夜行三百余里，及于当阳长坂。
刘备弃妻子，与诸葛亮、张飞、赵云等数十骑逃走。
赵云在乱军中身抱弱子，保护甘夫人，都得免难。
张飞率二十骑断后——
曹兵无敢近者。刘备与关羽船队会于汉津，又与刘表长子刘琦合，同到夏口。此前鲁肃已在当阳与刘备相会，孙刘联合由此开始。

prompt.zh:

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Three Kingdoms (220–280) · Changban: Zhao Yun and Zhang Fei (「长坂坡」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 58 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Setting: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 208 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

Characters:
- Zhao Yun (赵云) — general, Shu; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zhang Fei (张飞) — general, Shu; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Liu Bei (刘备) — ruler, Shu; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Cao Cao (曹操) — ruler, Wei; long robes, cloth headscarves; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Lady Gan (甘夫人) — royal / consort, Shu; long robes, cloth headscarves; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Liu Chan (刘禅) — royal / consort, Shu; long robes, cloth headscarves; noble prince's rich robes, jade pendants, formal cap and sash; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: grass; subject: crowd | Action: At Changban near Dangyang a hundred thousand civilians follow the army south | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「长坂坡」 with vermilion seal 「长坂」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「刘表死，其子刘琮降曹。刘备南走，荆州百姓十余万、辎重数千两随行，日行十余里。」
Shot 2 (10–18 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: smoke; subject: cavalry | Action: Cao's elite cavalry ride three hundred li in a day and night | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; ink spatters where hooves strike; pale ink smoke drifting sideways; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「曹操亲率精骑五千追赶，一日一夜行三百余里，及于当阳长坂。」
Shot 3 (18–25 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: subject: Zhao Yun, army ranks, forest of spears, war horse | Action: Zhao Yun carries the infant through the chaos | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: clashing weapons | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「身是张益德也，可来共决死」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「刘备弃妻子，与诸葛亮、张飞、赵云等数十骑逃走。」
Shot 4 (25–32 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: river; subject: Zhang Fei, spear | Action: Zhang Fei holds the broken bridge, glaring, spear levelled | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: war cries | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「赵云在乱军中身抱弱子，保护甘夫人，都得免难。」
Shot 5 (32–38 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: river; subject: cavalry; dry-brush calligraphy 「断桥」 | Action: No enemy dares come near | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; ink spatters where hooves strike; vignette closing in from the corners; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: war cries | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「张飞率二十骑断后——」
Shot 6 (38–52 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Liu Bei joins Guan Yu's fleet and Liu Qi at Xiakou; having met Lu Su at Dangyang, the Sun–Liu alliance begins. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「曹兵无敢近者。刘备与关羽船队会于汉津，又与刘表长子刘琦合，同到夏口。此前鲁肃已在当阳与刘备相会，孙刘联合由此开始。」
Shot 7 (52–58 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「身是张益德也，可来共决死」 signed 《三国志·蜀书·张飞传》; vermilion seal 「长坂」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「身是张益德也，可来共决死」

Sound: Music: war drums and horns, heroic, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: crowd murmur, distant battle, calm river; SFX: hoofbeats, clashing weapons, war cries; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「长坂坡」, subtitle 「赵云与张飞」, vermilion seal 「长坂」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「身是张益德也，可来共决死」 — 《三国志·蜀书·张飞传》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, detailed faces, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes

strings.scene.sanguo.chibi.title: 赤壁之战
strings.scene.sanguo.chibi.subtitle: 火烧战船
strings.vo.01: 建安十三年，曹操取荆州，顺江东下，书与孙权，号称水军八十万。
strings.vo.02: 诸葛亮出使江东，鲁肃、周瑜力主抗曹。孙权遂与刘备联合。
strings.vo.03: 两军遇于赤壁。周瑜部将黄盖说：曹军方连船舰，首尾相接，可烧而走也。
strings.vo.04: 黄盖取蒙冲斗舰数十艘，实以薪草，灌以膏油，诈称来降。时东南风急。
strings.vo.05: 去北军二里余，同时发火——
strings.scene.sanguo.chibi.fork.prompt: 赤壁之战——依《三国志》直书，还是听演义「草船借箭与借东风」？
strings.scene.sanguo.chibi.canon.intro: 曹操得荆州水军，顺江东下，遗书孙权：今治水军八十万众，方与将军会猎于吴。
strings.scene.sanguo.chibi.end.canon: 曹军烧溺死者甚众，曹操引军北还。孙刘各得荆州之地，三分之势渐成。
strings.scene.sanguo.chibi.pick.legend: 演义 · 草船借箭与借东风
strings.scene.sanguo.chibi.legend.disclaimer: 以下取自《三国演义》第四十六至四十九回，草船借箭、借东风都是小说情节；《魏略》载孙权乘船受箭之事，在建安十八年濡须口。
strings.scene.sanguo.chibi.legend.intro: 演义写诸葛亮三日造箭十万，以草船借箭；又在七星坛上作法，借来东南风。
strings.scene.sanguo.chibi.end.legend: 东风吹起，火船照旧出发。演义与正史在赤壁的火光中。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

sound.en: Music: war drums and horns, heroic, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: calm river, palace hall reverb, storm, fire; SFX: ringing blade, oars, distant drums, wind gust, roaring fire; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

narration: 建安十三年，曹操取荆州，顺江东下，书与孙权，号称水军八十万。
诸葛亮出使江东，鲁肃、周瑜力主抗曹。孙权遂与刘备联合。
两军遇于赤壁。周瑜部将黄盖说：曹军方连船舰，首尾相接，可烧而走也。
黄盖取蒙冲斗舰数十艘，实以薪草，灌以膏油，诈称来降。时东南风急。
去北军二里余，同时发火——
曹军烧溺死者甚众，曹操引军北还。孙刘各得荆州之地，三分之势渐成。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Three Kingdoms (220–280) · The Battle of Red Cliffs: Fire on the Fleet (「赤壁之战」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 54 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Setting: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 208 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

Characters:
- Huang Gai (黄盖) — general, Wu; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Cao Cao (曹操) — ruler, Cao; long robes, cloth headscarves; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

- Zhou Yu (周瑜) — general, Wu; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains, rock silhouettes; midground: river | Action: The great river flows east past the Red Cliffs | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「赤壁之战」 with vermilion seal 「赤壁」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「建安十三年，曹操取荆州，顺江东下，书与孙权，号称水军八十万。」
Shot 2 (8–16 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Sun Quan, Zhuge Liang | Action: At Chaisang Sun Quan cuts his desk with his sword | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: ringing blade | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「诸葛亮出使江东，鲁肃、周瑜力主抗曹。孙权遂与刘备联合。」
Shot 3 (16–25 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: boat; subject: Cao Cao, banners | Action: Cao's warships linked bow to stern | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: oars, distant drums | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「两军遇于赤壁。周瑜部将黄盖说：曹军方连船舰，首尾相接，可烧而走也。」
Shot 4 (25–33 s, 8 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: midground: boat, smoke; subject: Huang Gai | Action: Huang Gai's fire ships ride a fierce south-east wind | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; pale ink smoke drifting sideways | Sound: ambience: storm; SFX: wind gust | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「黄盖取蒙冲斗舰数十艘，实以薪草，灌以膏油，诈称来降。时东南风急。」
Shot 5 (33–39 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: boat; subject: fire (splashed ink); dry-brush calligraphy 「火攻」 | Action: Fierce fire, fierce wind | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; flat black flame silhouettes with a single vermilion core; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; vignette closing in from the corners; heat-haze and smoke distortion; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: fire; SFX: roaring fire | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「去北军二里余，同时发火——」
Shot 6 (39–48 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Many of Cao's men burn or drown and he retreats north; Sun and Liu take parts of Jing and the three-way division takes shape. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「曹军烧溺死者甚众，曹操引军北还。孙刘各得荆州之地，三分之势渐成。」
Shot 7 (48–54 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「赤壁」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

Sound: Music: war drums and horns, heroic, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: calm river, palace hall reverb, storm, fire; SFX: ringing blade, oars, distant drums, wind gust, roaring fire; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「赤壁之战」, subtitle 「火烧战船」, vermilion seal 「赤壁」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

strings.scene.sanguo.kongrong.title: 覆巢之下
strings.scene.sanguo.kongrong.subtitle: 孔融之死
strings.vo.01: 孔融是孔子的二十世孙，以文才名满天下。他退居闲职后，家中宾客日满，常说：座上客常满，尊中酒不空，吾无忧矣。
strings.vo.02: 他屡次写信讥讽曹操：曹操破邺城，曹丕纳袁熙之妻甄氏，孔融说当年武王伐纣，以妲己赐周公。曹操禁酒，他也写信反对。曹操授意路粹罗织他的罪状。
strings.vo.03: 建安十三年八月，曹操下令逮捕孔融。差役到家时，他的两个儿子正在庭中下棋，一个九岁，一个八岁。
strings.vo.04: 孔融对使者说：希望罪责只在我一人，两个孩子能不能保全？
strings.scene.sanguo.kongrong.quote: 大人岂见覆巢之下，复有完卵乎！
strings.scene.sanguo.kongrong.fork.prompt: 覆巢之下——依《后汉书》直书，还是听家传「融家传」？
strings.anchor.kongrongshu: 孔融屡次以书信讥讽曹操
strings.scene.sanguo.kongrong.pick.canon: 正史 · 《后汉书》、《三国志》所载
strings.scene.sanguo.kongrong.canon.intro: 一个以文章闻名天下的人，用文章讥讽了最有权势的人。来抓他的那一天，两个孩子还在下棋。
strings.scene.sanguo.kongrong.end.canon: 孔融与妻子儿女都被处死，时年五十六岁。他的朋友脂习抚尸痛哭，曹操也没有追究。孔融的诗文后来被曹丕搜集，列为建安七子之首。
strings.scene.sanguo.kongrong.legend.disclaimer: 以下取《后汉书·孔融传》李贤注引《融家传》所载“让梨”：孔融四岁与诸兄共食梨，独取小者。属家传轶事，后来编入蒙学《三字经》。
strings.scene.sanguo.kongrong.legend.intro: 融家传里说，孔融四岁时，与几个哥哥一起吃梨。
strings.scene.sanguo.kongrong.end.legend: 家传说，大人问他为什么拿小的，他说：我小儿，法当取小者。“融四岁，能让梨”后来写进了《三字经》，比他的死更为人所知。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 三国 · 建安十三年（208 年八月）。城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。
setting.en: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 208 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

characters.name: 孔融
characters.zh: 孔融（东汉·太中大夫，孔子二十世孙）：袍服，幅巾或纶巾；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；屡讥曹操，下狱弃市
characters.en: Kong Rong (孔融) — minister, Donghan; long robes, cloth headscarves; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.en: Cao Cao (曹操) — ruler, Cao; long robes, cloth headscarves; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.en: Lu Cui (路粹) — minister, Cao; long robes, cloth headscarves; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.en: Kong Rongzhizi (孔融之子) — commoner, Donghan; long robes, cloth headscarves; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 孔融是孔子的二十世孙，以文才名满天下。他退居闲职后，家中宾客日满，常说：座上客常满，尊中酒不空，吾无忧矣。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–12 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：孔融、众人｜动作：太中大夫府中宾客满座，主人举杯说：座上客常满，尊中酒不空，吾无忧矣｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：人群低语；音效：碰杯｜屏幕文字：片名「覆巢之下」竖排书法与朱印「覆巢」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「孔融是孔子的二十世孙，以文才名满天下。他退居闲职后，家中宾客日满，常说：座上客常满，尊中酒不空，吾无忧矣。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–12 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Kong Rong, crowd | Action: Kong Rong's hall is full of guests; he raises his cup: the seats always full, the cups never empty, what have I to worry about | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: clinking cups | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「覆巢之下」 with vermilion seal 「覆巢」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孔融是孔子的二十世孙，以文才名满天下。他退居闲职后，家中宾客日满，常说：座上客常满，尊中酒不空，吾无忧矣。」

shots.vo: 他屡次写信讥讽曹操：曹操破邺城，曹丕纳袁熙之妻甄氏，孔融说当年武王伐纣，以妲己赐周公。曹操禁酒，他也写信反对。曹操授意路粹罗织他的罪状。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（12–28 秒，16 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：曹操、路粹｜动作：丞相府里，一卷罪状摊开在案上｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他屡次写信讥讽曹操：曹操破邺城，曹丕纳袁熙之妻甄氏，孔融说当年武王伐纣，以妲己赐周公。曹操禁酒，他也写信反对。曹操授意路粹罗织他的罪状。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (12–28 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Cao Cao, Lu Cui | Action: In the chancellor's office a scroll of charges lies open on the desk | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他屡次写信讥讽曹操：曹操破邺城，曹丕纳袁熙之妻甄氏，孔融说当年武王伐纣，以妲己赐周公。曹操禁酒，他也写信反对。曹操授意路粹罗织他的罪状。」

shots.vo: 建安十三年八月，曹操下令逮捕孔融。差役到家时，他的两个儿子正在庭中下棋，一个九岁，一个八岁。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（28–39 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：手持式轻微震动，节奏急促｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：孔融之子、众人｜动作：差役闯进孔府，两个孩子还在庭中下棋｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：人群低语；音效：门轴吱呀｜屏幕文字：引文「大人岂见覆巢之下，复有完卵乎！」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「建安十三年八月，曹操下令逮捕孔融。差役到家时，他的两个儿子正在庭中下棋，一个九岁，一个八岁。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (28–39 s, 11 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Kong Rongzhizi, crowd | Action: Constables burst into the Kong house while two children are still playing chess in the courtyard | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: creaking door | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「大人岂见覆巢之下，复有完卵乎！」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「建安十三年八月，曹操下令逮捕孔融。差役到家时，他的两个儿子正在庭中下棋，一个九岁，一个八岁。」

shots.vo: 孔融对使者说：希望罪责只在我一人，两个孩子能不能保全？
shots.zh: 镜头 4（39–47 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：孔融、孔融之子｜动作：孔融回头说：希望罪止于我一人，两个孩子能保全吗｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：静默｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「孔融对使者说：希望罪责只在我一人，两个孩子能不能保全？」
shots.en: Shot 4 (39–47 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Kong Rong, Kong Rongzhizi | Action: Kong Rong turns: let the guilt end with me; can the two children be spared | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: silence | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孔融对使者说：希望罪责只在我一人，两个孩子能不能保全？」

shots.vo: 孩子却不慌不忙地说——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（47–53 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：孔融之子；飞白题字「覆巢」｜动作：孩子从容站起：大人岂见覆巢之下，复有完卵乎｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：城门闭合｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「孩子却不慌不忙地说——」

narration: 孔融是孔子的二十世孙，以文才名满天下。他退居闲职后，家中宾客日满，常说：座上客常满，尊中酒不空，吾无忧矣。
他屡次写信讥讽曹操：曹操破邺城，曹丕纳袁熙之妻甄氏，孔融说当年武王伐纣，以妲己赐周公。曹操禁酒，他也写信反对。曹操授意路粹罗织他的罪状。
建安十三年八月，曹操下令逮捕孔融。差役到家时，他的两个儿子正在庭中下棋，一个九岁，一个八岁。
孔融对使者说：希望罪责只在我一人，两个孩子能不能保全？
孩子却不慌不忙地说——
孔融与妻子儿女都被处死，时年五十六岁。他的朋友脂习抚尸痛哭，曹操也没有追究。孔融的诗文后来被曹丕搜集，列为建安七子之首。
大人岂见覆巢之下，复有完卵乎！

strings.scene.sanguo.huatuo.title: 华佗之死
strings.scene.sanguo.huatuo.subtitle: 青囊不传
strings.vo.01: 华佗精通医术，尤其擅长针灸和外科。曹操苦于头风，每次发作就心乱目眩，华佗针刺膈俞，随手而愈。
strings.vo.02: 他教弟子吴普一套五禽之戏，模仿虎、鹿、熊、猿、鸟的动作活动筋骨。吴普照着做，活到九十多岁，耳聪目明，齿牙完坚。
strings.vo.03: 华佗不愿以医为业专门侍奉曹操，借口妻子生病回乡，屡次不归。曹操派人查验，发现他的妻子并没有病，便把他关进许昌狱中。荀彧求情，曹操不听。
strings.vo.04: 临死前，华佗拿出一卷书交给狱吏，说：此可以活人。狱吏怕违法，不敢接受。
strings.vo.05: 华佗也不勉强，向人要来火——
strings.scene.sanguo.huatuo.fork.prompt: 华佗之死——依《三国志》直书，还是听演义《三国演义》？
strings.anchor.toufeng: 曹操苦头风，召华佗随侍
strings.anchor.shaoshu: 华佗死于狱中，所著医书被焚
strings.scene.sanguo.huatuo.pick.canon: 正史 · 《三国志》、《后汉书》所载
strings.scene.sanguo.huatuo.canon.intro: 一位治好了丞相头风的医生，不愿只做一个人的医生。临死前，他手里还有一卷能救人的书。
strings.scene.sanguo.huatuo.end.canon: 华佗死后，曹操的头风仍然发作。后来爱子曹冲病危，曹操叹道：吾悔杀华佗，令此儿强死也。华佗的医书没有传下来，只有弟子吴普、樊阿等人传其一二。
strings.scene.sanguo.huatuo.legend.disclaimer: 以下取明代小说《三国演义》第七十八回“治风疾神医身死”：小说把华佗之死移到曹操临终前，改为华佗提出用利斧砍开头颅取出风涎，曹操疑其谋害而杀之；又有狱吏吴押狱得《青囊书》、其妻焚书的情节。均为小说虚构。
strings.scene.sanguo.huatuo.legend.intro: 演义里，华佗对头痛欲裂的曹操说：大王脑袋里有风涎，须先饮麻沸汤，然后用利斧砍开脑袋。
strings.scene.sanguo.huatuo.end.legend: 演义里吴押狱的妻子说：纵然学得与华佗一般神妙，只落得死于牢中。她把《青囊书》烧了，只抢下一两页，据说只剩下阉鸡猪的小法。
strings.scene.sanguo.huatuo.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若狱吏受书（未开放）

画风：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）——大块黑色剪影与平涂灰阶，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白；少纹理、少装饰；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：3×2 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。
清单：
第 1 行：1. 泼墨墨点飞溅；2. 飞白笔触；3. 水流笔迹。
第 2 行：4. 墨滴下坠；5. 火（过场笔画所绘）；6. 留空。
排版参考尺寸：1536×1024 像素，每格按 512×512 切分；实际生成尺寸以所用服务返回值为准，裁切前须确认比例与透明通道。只有墨线与墨块，不加任何文字、书法、印章、边框、网格线、水印。
artPrompts.negative: 文字, 书法, 题字, 印章, 边框, 网格线, 底纹, 纸纹, 背景色, 白底, 阴影, 倒影, 水印, 写实照片, 3D 渲染, 厚涂, 现代器物, 现代服饰, 多余肢体, 五官崩坏, 全彩, 多色, 粉彩, 马卡龙色, Q 版, 萌系, 大头娃娃, 精细繁复纹理, 大量渐变的 CG 质感, 金色高光, 蒸汽朋克机械, 细密界画线条, 复杂五官

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 三国 · 建安十三年前（约 208 年）。城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。
setting.en: Three Kingdoms (220–280), c. 208 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

characters.name: 华佗
characters.zh: 华佗（东汉·沛国谯人，医者）：袍服，幅巾或纶巾；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；针鬲疗头风，以妻病为由不归，下狱考竟
characters.en: Hua Tuo (华佗) — scholar, Donghan; long robes, cloth headscarves; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 曹操
characters.zh: 曹操（曹·丞相）：袍服，幅巾或纶巾；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；苦头风；怒佗不至，杀之
characters.en: Cao Cao (曹操) — ruler, Cao; long robes, cloth headscarves; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 吴普
characters.zh: 吴普（东汉·华佗弟子）：袍服，幅巾或纶巾；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；习五禽之戏，年九十余耳目聪明
characters.en: Wu Pu (吴普) — scholar, Donghan; long robes, cloth headscarves; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 狱吏
characters.zh: 狱吏（曹·许昌狱中狱吏）：袍服，幅巾或纶巾；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；畏法不敢受佗之书
characters.en: Yu Li (狱吏) — commoner, Cao; long robes, cloth headscarves; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 华佗精通医术，尤其擅长针灸和外科。曹操苦于头风，每次发作就心乱目眩，华佗针刺膈俞，随手而愈。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–11 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：曹操、华佗｜动作：丞相头痛发作，在帐中抱头不起，医者把一根针刺进他的膈俞｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：静默｜屏幕文字：片名「华佗之死」竖排书法与朱印「青囊」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「华佗精通医术，尤其擅长针灸和外科。曹操苦于头风，每次发作就心乱目眩，华佗针刺膈俞，随手而愈。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–11 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Cao Cao, Hua Tuo | Action: The chancellor clutches his head in a migraine as the physician slips a needle into his back | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: silence | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「华佗之死」 with vermilion seal 「青囊」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「华佗精通医术，尤其擅长针灸和外科。曹操苦于头风，每次发作就心乱目眩，华佗针刺膈俞，随手而愈。」

shots.vo: 他教弟子吴普一套五禽之戏，模仿虎、鹿、熊、猿、鸟的动作活动筋骨。吴普照着做，活到九十多岁，耳聪目明，齿牙完坚。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（11–23 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：近山与地面；主体：华佗、吴普｜动作：医者对弟子比划着虎、鹿、熊、猿、鸟的动作｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：环境：低风；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「他教弟子吴普一套五禽之戏，模仿虎、鹿、熊、猿、鸟的动作活动筋骨。吴普照着做，活到九十多岁，耳聪目明，齿牙完坚。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (11–23 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: near hills and ground; subject: Hua Tuo, Wu Pu | Action: The physician shows his disciple the moves of tiger, deer, bear, ape and bird | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他教弟子吴普一套五禽之戏，模仿虎、鹿、熊、猿、鸟的动作活动筋骨。吴普照着做，活到九十多岁，耳聪目明，齿牙完坚。」

shots.vo: 华佗不愿以医为业专门侍奉曹操，借口妻子生病回乡，屡次不归。曹操派人查验，发现他的妻子并没有病，便把他关进许昌狱中。荀彧求情，曹操不听。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（23–39 秒，16 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：近山与地面；主体：华佗、众人｜动作：告假回乡的医者迟迟不归，信使在门外催促｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：低风；音效：门轴吱呀｜屏幕文字：引文「此可以活人。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「华佗不愿以医为业专门侍奉曹操，借口妻子生病回乡，屡次不归。曹操派人查验，发现他的妻子并没有病，便把他关进许昌狱中。荀彧求情，曹操不听。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (23–39 s, 16 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: near hills and ground; subject: Hua Tuo, crowd | Action: The physician on leave at home stays away; a messenger presses at the gate | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: low wind; SFX: creaking door | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「此可以活人。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「华佗不愿以医为业专门侍奉曹操，借口妻子生病回乡，屡次不归。曹操派人查验，发现他的妻子并没有病，便把他关进许昌狱中。荀彧求情，曹操不听。」

shots.vo: 临死前，华佗拿出一卷书交给狱吏，说：此可以活人。狱吏怕违法，不敢接受。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（39–48 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：华佗、狱吏｜动作：许昌狱中，他把一卷书递向狱吏，狱吏缩手不接｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：锁链｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「临死前，华佗拿出一卷书交给狱吏，说：此可以活人。狱吏怕违法，不敢接受。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (39–48 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Hua Tuo, Yu Li | Action: In the Xu prison he holds out a scroll to the jailer, who draws back his hand | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: chains | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「临死前，华佗拿出一卷书交给狱吏，说：此可以活人。狱吏怕违法，不敢接受。」

shots.vo: 华佗也不勉强，向人要来火——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（48–54 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐、书写；主体：华佗、火；飞白题字「青囊」｜动作：他向狱卒要来火，把书投进火里｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；黑色立柱剪影切分画面，纵深三层灰；平涂黑焰剪影，焰心一抹朱红；四角暗角收拢；热浪与烟气扭曲；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：火声；音效：烈火｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「华佗也不勉强，向人要来火——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (48–54 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, 书写; subject: Hua Tuo, fire (splashed ink); dry-brush calligraphy 「青囊」 | Action: He asks for fire and drops the book into the flames | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth; flat black flame silhouettes with a single vermilion core; vignette closing in from the corners; heat-haze and smoke distortion; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: fire; SFX: roaring fire | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「华佗也不勉强，向人要来火——」

shots.vo: 华佗死后，曹操的头风仍然发作。后来爱子曹冲病危，曹操叹道：吾悔杀华佗，令此儿强死也。华佗的医书没有传下来，只有弟子吴普、樊阿等人传其一二。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（54–70 秒，16 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：华佗｜动作：正史结局：华佗死后，曹操的头风仍然发作。后来爱子曹冲病危，曹操叹道：吾悔杀华佗，令此儿强死也。华佗的医书没有传下来，只有弟子吴普、樊阿等人传其一二。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「华佗死后，曹操的头风仍然发作。后来爱子曹冲病危，曹操叹道：吾悔杀华佗，令此儿强死也。华佗的医书没有传下来，只有弟子吴普、樊阿等人传其一二。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (54–70 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Hua Tuo | Action: Canonical outcome: Cao Cao's headaches persist; when his beloved son Cao Chong lies dying he laments, I regret killing Hua Tuo, and the physician's book is lost, with only his disciples passing on fragments. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「华佗死后，曹操的头风仍然发作。后来爱子曹冲病危，曹操叹道：吾悔杀华佗，令此儿强死也。华佗的医书没有传下来，只有弟子吴普、樊阿等人传其一二。」

shots.vo: 此可以活人。
shots.zh: 镜头 7（70–76 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「此可以活人。」，下署《三国志·魏书·方技传》；右下角朱印「青囊」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「此可以活人。」
shots.en: Shot 7 (70–76 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「此可以活人。」 signed 《三国志·魏书·方技传》; vermilion seal 「青囊」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「此可以活人。」

sound.zh: 背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：寂静室内、低风、火声；音效：静默、脚步声、门轴吱呀、锁链、烈火；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: quiet room tone, low wind, fire; SFX: silence, footsteps, creaking door, chains, roaring fire; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 片头：右上竖排书法片名「华佗之死」，副题「青囊不传」，朱印「青囊」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；引文：「此可以活人。」——《三国志·魏书·方技传》，竖排楷书；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。
onScreenText.en: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「华佗之死」, subtitle 「青囊不传」, vermilion seal 「青囊」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「此可以活人。」 — 《三国志·魏书·方技传》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

narration: 华佗精通医术，尤其擅长针灸和外科。曹操苦于头风，每次发作就心乱目眩，华佗针刺膈俞，随手而愈。
他教弟子吴普一套五禽之戏，模仿虎、鹿、熊、猿、鸟的动作活动筋骨。吴普照着做，活到九十多岁，耳聪目明，齿牙完坚。
华佗不愿以医为业专门侍奉曹操，借口妻子生病回乡，屡次不归。曹操派人查验，发现他的妻子并没有病，便把他关进许昌狱中。荀彧求情，曹操不听。
临死前，华佗拿出一卷书交给狱吏，说：此可以活人。狱吏怕违法，不敢接受。
华佗也不勉强，向人要来火——
华佗死后，曹操的头风仍然发作。后来爱子曹冲病危，曹操叹道：吾悔杀华佗，令此儿强死也。华佗的医书没有传下来，只有弟子吴普、樊阿等人传其一二。
此可以活人。

strings.vo.01: 刘备取得益州，孙权遣使索还荆州诸郡。刘备说：待我取得凉州，便以荆州相与。
strings.vo.02: 孙权大怒，派吕蒙袭取长沙、零陵、桂阳三郡，又命鲁肃屯益阳，与关羽相拒。
strings.vo.03: 鲁肃邀关羽相见，各驻兵马于百步之外，只有将军们佩单刀赴会。
strings.vo.04: 鲁肃当面责备关羽：我国家区区本以土地借卿家者，卿家军败远来，无以为资故也。
strings.vo.05: 话还没说完，座中有一人说：夫土地者，惟德所在耳，何常之有——
strings.scene.sanguo.dandao.quote: 肃邀羽相见，各驻兵马百步上，但请将军单刀俱会
strings.scene.sanguo.dandao.fork.prompt: 单刀会——依《三国志》直书，还是听演义「关云长单刀赴会」？
strings.scene.sanguo.dandao.pick.canon: 正史 · 《三国志·鲁肃传》所载
strings.scene.sanguo.dandao.canon.intro: 益阳城外，两边的兵马各退到百步之外。鲁肃与关羽只带佩刀，相对而坐。
strings.scene.sanguo.dandao.end.canon: 关羽操刀起身，让那人离去。不久曹操攻入汉中，刘备恐失益州，与孙权和解，分荆州：湘水以东归吴，以西归刘。
strings.scene.sanguo.dandao.pick.legend: 演义 · 关云长单刀赴会
strings.scene.sanguo.dandao.legend.disclaimer: 以下按元代关汉卿杂剧与《三国演义》第六十六回改编：演义把主角换成关羽，写他只带周仓一人、单刀赴宴，挟持鲁肃登船而去，这与正史相反。
strings.scene.sanguo.dandao.legend.intro: 演义说：鲁肃设宴，埋伏刀斧手，想逼关羽归还荆州。关羽只带周仓与数人，提着青龙刀赴会。
strings.scene.sanguo.dandao.end.legend: 关羽登船而去。演义的结局与正史不同，故事回到正史：湘水分界。
strings.scene.sanguo.dandao.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若会谈破裂（未开放）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

shots.vo: 刘备取得益州，孙权遣使索还荆州诸郡。刘备说：待我取得凉州，便以荆州相与。

shots.en: Shot 1 (0–9 s, 9 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: river, army tents | Action: Two armies face each other on the river at Yiyang | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「单刀会」 with vermilion seal 「单刀会」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「刘备取得益州，孙权遣使索还荆州诸郡。刘备说：待我取得凉州，便以荆州相与。」

narration: 刘备取得益州，孙权遣使索还荆州诸郡。刘备说：待我取得凉州，便以荆州相与。
孙权大怒，派吕蒙袭取长沙、零陵、桂阳三郡，又命鲁肃屯益阳，与关羽相拒。
鲁肃邀关羽相见，各驻兵马于百步之外，只有将军们佩单刀赴会。
鲁肃当面责备关羽：我国家区区本以土地借卿家者，卿家军败远来，无以为资故也。
话还没说完，座中有一人说：夫土地者，惟德所在耳，何常之有——
关羽操刀起身，让那人离去。不久曹操攻入汉中，刘备恐失益州，与孙权和解，分荆州：湘水以东归吴，以西归刘。

字幕与屏幕文字：片头：右上竖排书法片名「单刀会」，副题「鲁肃与关羽」，朱印「单刀会」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；引文：「肃邀羽相见，各驻兵马百步上，但请将军单刀俱会」——《三国志·吴书·鲁肃传》，竖排楷书；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Three Kingdoms (220–280) · The Single-Sword Meeting: Lu Su and Guan Yu (「单刀会」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 62 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Setting: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 215 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

Characters:
- Lu Su (鲁肃) — general, Wu; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Guan Yu (关羽) — general, Shu; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Sun Quan (孙权) — ruler, Wu; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Lü Meng (吕蒙) — general, Wu; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Liu Bei (刘备) — ruler, Shu; long robes, cloth headscarves; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–9 s, 9 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: river, army tents | Action: Two armies face each other on the river at Yiyang | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「单刀会」 with vermilion seal 「单刀会」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「刘备取得益州，孙权遣使索还荆州诸郡。刘备说：待我取得凉州，便以荆州相与。」
Shot 2 (9–18 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: river; subject: army ranks, forest of spears, banners | Action: Each side keeps its troops a hundred paces back | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: distant drums | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孙权大怒，派吕蒙袭取长沙、零陵、桂阳三郡，又命鲁肃屯益阳，与关羽相拒。」
Shot 3 (18–26 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: subject: Lu Su, Guan Yu, broadsword | Action: The generals meet bearing only their swords | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「肃邀羽相见，各驻兵马百步上，但请将军单刀俱会」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「鲁肃邀关羽相见，各驻兵马于百步之外，只有将军们佩单刀赴会。」
Shot 4 (26–36 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Lu Su, Guan Yu | Action: Lu Su reproaches Guan Yu; a man in the audience cuts in | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: murmuring | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「鲁肃当面责备关羽：我国家区区本以土地借卿家者，卿家军败远来，无以为资故也。」
Shot 5 (36–44 s, 8 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: subject: broadsword; dry-brush calligraphy 「单刀」 | Action: Guan Yu rises, blade in hand | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; a cold metallic glint on the blade; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: ringing blade | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「话还没说完，座中有一人说：夫土地者，惟德所在耳，何常之有——」
Shot 6 (44–56 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Guan Yu sends the man away; soon Cao Cao takes Hanzhong, and Liu Bei splits Jing province with Sun Quan along the Xiang River. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「关羽操刀起身，让那人离去。不久曹操攻入汉中，刘备恐失益州，与孙权和解，分荆州：湘水以东归吴，以西归刘。」
Shot 7 (56–62 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「肃邀羽相见，各驻兵马百步上，但请将军单刀俱会」 signed 《三国志·吴书·鲁肃传》; vermilion seal 「单刀会」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「肃邀羽相见，各驻兵马百步上，但请将军单刀俱会」

Sound: Music: war drums and horns, heroic, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: calm river, wind over open plains, quiet room tone; SFX: distant drums, footsteps, murmuring, ringing blade; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「单刀会」, subtitle 「鲁肃与关羽」, vermilion seal 「单刀会」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「肃邀羽相见，各驻兵马百步上，但请将军单刀俱会」 — 《三国志·吴书·鲁肃传》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, detailed faces, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes

strings.scene.sanguo.hefei.title: 威震逍遥津
strings.scene.sanguo.hefei.subtitle: 八百破十万
strings.vo.01: 建安二十年，曹操西征张鲁，留张辽、李典、乐进带七千多人守合肥。他留下一个木匣，写着：贼至乃发。孙权率十万大军来攻，众将打开木匣，里面写着：若孙权至者，张、李将军出战，乐将军守护军，勿得与战。
strings.vo.02: 张辽连夜招募了八百名敢死之士，宰牛犒劳。
strings.vo.03: 天亮时，他披甲持戟，第一个冲入敌阵，杀了几十个人，斩了两员将领，大呼自己的名字，一直冲到孙权的大旗之下。
strings.vo.04: 孙权大惊，退到高冢上用长戟自守。张辽在阵中往来冲杀，吴军夺气。孙权围城十几天，攻不下来，只好撤兵。张辽又率步骑追袭到逍遥津北。
strings.vo.05: 孙权骑马跑到津桥，桥南已被拆断一丈多。亲近监谷利在马后加了一鞭——
strings.scene.sanguo.hefei.quote: 辽被甲持戟，先登陷陈，杀数十人，斩二将，大呼自名，冲垒入，至权麾下。
strings.scene.sanguo.hefei.fork.prompt: 威震逍遥津——依《三国志》直书，还是听演义《三国演义》？
strings.anchor.quantui: 孙权撤围，在逍遥津遇袭，跃马过桥
strings.scene.sanguo.hefei.canon.intro: 七千人守一座孤城，十万人来攻。守将打开了曹操留下的木匣，决定先出城迎战。
strings.scene.sanguo.hefei.end.canon: 孙权的马跃过了断桥。凌统率亲兵三百人在桥北死战，左右全部战死，他自己负伤，泅水逃回。曹操对张辽大为赞赏，拜他为征东将军。
strings.scene.sanguo.hefei.legend.disclaimer: 以下取明代小说《三国演义》第六十七回“张辽威震逍遥津”：小说添了太史慈中计战死、甘宁百骑劫营等情节，也敷演了孙权跃马过桥一段。民间“张辽止啼”的说法亦与此战有关，见于后世笔记。
strings.scene.sanguo.hefei.legend.intro: 演义里，孙权的马跳过断桥时，江东士卒在后面看得心惊胆战。
strings.scene.sanguo.hefei.end.legend: 演义的结局与正史相同：孙权逃脱，张辽威名震于江东。后世流传江东小儿夜啼，大人说“辽来”便不敢哭。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 三国 · 建安二十年（215 年八月）。城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。
setting.en: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 215 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

characters.en: Zhang Liao (张辽) — general, Wei; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 建安二十年，曹操西征张鲁，留张辽、李典、乐进带七千多人守合肥。他留下一个木匣，写着：贼至乃发。孙权率十万大军来攻，众将打开木匣，里面写着：若孙权至者，张、李将军出战，乐将军守护军，勿得与战。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–20 秒，20 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：主体：张辽、李典、盾墙｜动作：合肥城头，一个木匣打开，里面是曹操的手令：若孙权至者，张、李将军出战｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：军营鼓声；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：片名「威震逍遥津」竖排书法与朱印「逍遥津」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「建安二十年，曹操西征张鲁，留张辽、李典、乐进带七千多人守合肥。他留下一个木匣，写着：贼至乃发。孙权率十万大军来攻，众将打开木匣，里面写着：若孙权至者，张、李将军出战，乐将军守护军，勿得与战。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–20 s, 20 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: subject: Zhang Liao, Li Dian, shield wall | Action: On the walls of Hefei a wooden box is opened: Cao Cao's order says if Sun Quan comes, Zhang and Li go out to fight | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「威震逍遥津」 with vermilion seal 「逍遥津」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「建安二十年，曹操西征张鲁，留张辽、李典、乐进带七千多人守合肥。他留下一个木匣，写着：贼至乃发。孙权率十万大军来攻，众将打开木匣，里面写着：若孙权至者，张、李将军出战，乐将军守护军，勿得与战。」

shots.vo: 张辽连夜招募了八百名敢死之士，宰牛犒劳。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（20–26 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：营帐；主体：张辽、盾墙、火｜动作：夜里，城中宰牛犒军，八百人吃饱了饭｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白；平涂黑焰剪影，焰心一抹朱红；热浪与烟气扭曲｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：人群低语｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「张辽连夜招募了八百名敢死之士，宰牛犒劳。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (20–26 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Zhang Liao, shield wall, fire (splashed ink) | Action: At night oxen are slaughtered in the city and eight hundred men eat their fill | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; flat black flame silhouettes with a single vermilion core; heat-haze and smoke distortion | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: crowd murmur | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「张辽连夜招募了八百名敢死之士，宰牛犒劳。」

shots.vo: 天亮时，他披甲持戟，第一个冲入敌阵，杀了几十个人，斩了两员将领，大呼自己的名字，一直冲到孙权的大旗之下。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（26–38 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：手持式轻微震动，节奏急促｜构图：主体：张辽、军阵、长兵如林、长枪、旌旗｜动作：天刚亮，张辽披甲持戟冲进吴军，大呼自己的名字｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；枯笔竖线密如森林；兵刃金属寒光一闪｜声音：环境：battle-roar；音效：喊杀｜屏幕文字：引文「辽被甲持戟，先登陷陈，杀数十人，斩二将，大呼自名，冲垒入，至权麾下。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「天亮时，他披甲持戟，第一个冲入敌阵，杀了几十个人，斩了两员将领，大呼自己的名字，一直冲到孙权的大旗之下。」

shots.vo: 孙权大惊，退到高冢上用长戟自守。张辽在阵中往来冲杀，吴军夺气。孙权围城十几天，攻不下来，只好撤兵。张辽又率步骑追袭到逍遥津北。

narration: 建安二十年，曹操西征张鲁，留张辽、李典、乐进带七千多人守合肥。他留下一个木匣，写着：贼至乃发。孙权率十万大军来攻，众将打开木匣，里面写着：若孙权至者，张、李将军出战，乐将军守护军，勿得与战。
张辽连夜招募了八百名敢死之士，宰牛犒劳。
天亮时，他披甲持戟，第一个冲入敌阵，杀了几十个人，斩了两员将领，大呼自己的名字，一直冲到孙权的大旗之下。
孙权大惊，退到高冢上用长戟自守。张辽在阵中往来冲杀，吴军夺气。孙权围城十几天，攻不下来，只好撤兵。张辽又率步骑追袭到逍遥津北。
孙权骑马跑到津桥，桥南已被拆断一丈多。亲近监谷利在马后加了一鞭——
孙权的马跃过了断桥。凌统率亲兵三百人在桥北死战，左右全部战死，他自己负伤，泅水逃回。曹操对张辽大为赞赏，拜他为征东将军。
辽被甲持戟，先登陷陈，杀数十人，斩二将，大呼自名，冲垒入，至权麾下。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Three Kingdoms (220–280) · Terror at Xiaoyao Ford: Eight Hundred Against a Hundred Thousand (「威震逍遥津」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 82 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Setting: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 215 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

Characters:
- Zhang Liao (张辽) — general, Wei; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Sun Quan (孙权) — ruler, Wu; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Li Dian (李典) — general, Wei; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Gu Li (谷利) — commoner, Wu; long robes, cloth headscarves; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Ling Tong (凌统) — general, Wu; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–20 s, 20 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: subject: Zhang Liao, Li Dian, shield wall | Action: On the walls of Hefei a wooden box is opened: Cao Cao's order says if Sun Quan comes, Zhang and Li go out to fight | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「威震逍遥津」 with vermilion seal 「逍遥津」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「建安二十年，曹操西征张鲁，留张辽、李典、乐进带七千多人守合肥。他留下一个木匣，写着：贼至乃发。孙权率十万大军来攻，众将打开木匣，里面写着：若孙权至者，张、李将军出战，乐将军守护军，勿得与战。」
Shot 2 (20–26 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Zhang Liao, shield wall, fire (splashed ink) | Action: At night oxen are slaughtered in the city and eight hundred men eat their fill | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; flat black flame silhouettes with a single vermilion core; heat-haze and smoke distortion | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: crowd murmur | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「张辽连夜招募了八百名敢死之士，宰牛犒劳。」
Shot 3 (26–38 s, 12 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: subject: Zhang Liao, army ranks, forest of spears, spear, banners | Action: At dawn Zhang Liao in armour charges the Wu lines with his halberd, shouting his own name | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: battle roar; SFX: war cries | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「辽被甲持戟，先登陷陈，杀数十人，斩二将，大呼自名，冲垒入，至权麾下。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「天亮时，他披甲持戟，第一个冲入敌阵，杀了几十个人，斩了两员将领，大呼自己的名字，一直冲到孙权的大旗之下。」
Shot 4 (38–53 s, 15 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: near hills and ground; subject: Sun Quan, army ranks, forest of spears | Action: Sun Quan retreats onto a high mound, guarding himself with a long halberd, watching eight hundred men cut through a hundred thousand | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears | Sound: ambience: battle roar; SFX: clashing weapons | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孙权大惊，退到高冢上用长戟自守。张辽在阵中往来冲杀，吴军夺气。孙权围城十几天，攻不下来，只好撤兵。张辽又率步骑追袭到逍遥津北。」
Shot 5 (53–62 s, 9 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: river; subject: Sun Quan, Gu Li, war horse; dry-brush calligraphy 「逍遥津」 | Action: The bridge at Xiaoyao Ford is broken for more than ten feet; a fine horse leaps the gap | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; vignette closing in from the corners; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: river rapid; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孙权骑马跑到津桥，桥南已被拆断一丈多。亲近监谷利在马后加了一鞭——」
Shot 6 (62–76 s, 14 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Sun Quan, Gu Li | Action: Canonical outcome: Sun Quan's horse clears the bridge; Ling Tong fights on north of it until his men all fall, then swims back wounded, and Cao Cao names Zhang Liao General Who Conquers the East. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孙权的马跃过了断桥。凌统率亲兵三百人在桥北死战，左右全部战死，他自己负伤，泅水逃回。曹操对张辽大为赞赏，拜他为征东将军。」
Shot 7 (76–82 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「辽被甲持戟，先登陷陈，杀数十人，斩二将，大呼自名，冲垒入，至权麾下。」 signed 《三国志·魏书·张辽传》; vermilion seal 「逍遥津」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「辽被甲持戟，先登陷陈，杀数十人，斩二将，大呼自名，冲垒入，至权麾下。」

Sound: Music: war drums and horns, heroic, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: camp drums, night wind, battle roar, river rapid; SFX: rustling silk, crowd murmur, war cries, clashing weapons, hoofbeats; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「威震逍遥津」, subtitle 「八百破十万」, vermilion seal 「逍遥津」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「辽被甲持戟，先登陷陈，杀数十人，斩二将，大呼自名，冲垒入，至权麾下。」 — 《三国志·魏书·张辽传》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

strings.scene.sanguo.qijun.title: 水淹七军
strings.scene.sanguo.qijun.subtitle: 走麦城
strings.vo.01: 建安二十四年，关羽率众攻曹仁于樊。曹操遣于禁助仁。
strings.vo.02: 秋，大霖雨，汉水泛溢，于禁所督七军皆没。于禁降，庞德不屈而死。
strings.vo.03: 关羽威震华夏，曹操一度议徙许都以避其锐。
strings.vo.04: 孙权却派吕蒙袭取江陵。吕蒙把精兵藏在船中，使白衣摇橹，作商贾人服。南郡太守糜芳出降。
strings.scene.sanguo.qijun.fork.prompt: 水淹七军——依《三国志》直书，还是听演义「刮骨疗毒」？
strings.scene.sanguo.qijun.canon.intro: 樊城外，雨已经下了十几天。汉水一天比一天高，漫过了于禁的营地。
strings.scene.sanguo.qijun.end.canon: 十二月，孙权将马忠擒关羽及其子关平于章乡，斩之于临沮。荆州尽归东吴。
strings.scene.sanguo.qijun.legend.disclaimer: 关羽刮骨疗毒见于《三国志·关羽传》，但医者不知姓名；以下按《三国演义》第七十五至七十七回改编：华佗刮骨、玉泉山显圣都是小说情节（华佗此时已死）。
strings.scene.sanguo.qijun.legend.intro: 演义说：关羽中了毒箭，名医华佗前来，为他刮骨去毒。关羽一边饮酒下棋，一边任华佗刮骨，谈笑自若。
strings.scene.sanguo.qijun.end.legend: 演义的传说止于玉泉山。正史中，关羽死于临沮。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 三国 · 东汉建安二十四年（219 年）。城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。
setting.en: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 219 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

shots.vo: 建安二十四年，关羽率众攻曹仁于樊。曹操遣于禁助仁。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–7 秒，7 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：河水、城墙雉堞｜动作：汉水之滨，樊城孤立｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：平缓河水｜屏幕文字：片名「水淹七军」竖排书法与朱印「威震华夏」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「建安二十四年，关羽率众攻曹仁于樊。曹操遣于禁助仁。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–7 s, 7 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: river, crenellated city wall | Action: Fancheng stands isolated on the Han River | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; scorched-ink outline of battlements; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「水淹七军」 with vermilion seal 「威震华夏」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「建安二十四年，关羽率众攻曹仁于樊。曹操遣于禁助仁。」

shots.vo: 秋，大霖雨，汉水泛溢，于禁所督七军皆没。于禁降，庞德不屈而死。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（7–15 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：洪水、营帐；飞白题字「雨」｜动作：秋，大霖雨，汉水溢｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；细密斜线笔触成雨；浓淡墨层层涌动成洪流；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：大雨；音效：雷声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「秋，大霖雨，汉水泛溢，于禁所督七军皆没。于禁降，庞德不屈而死。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (7–15 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: flood waters, army tents; dry-brush calligraphy 「雨」 | Action: Autumn rains; the Han overflows | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; fine slanted strokes for rain; layered dark and pale ink surging as a flood; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: heavy rain; SFX: thunder | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「秋，大霖雨，汉水泛溢，于禁所督七军皆没。于禁降，庞德不屈而死。」

shots.vo: 关羽威震华夏，曹操一度议徙许都以避其锐。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（15–21 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：洪水、舟；主体：庞德、弓箭｜动作：于禁七军皆没，庞德立于堤上｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；浓淡墨层层涌动成洪流；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：洪水咆哮；音效：放箭｜屏幕文字：引文「羽威震华夏」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「关羽威震华夏，曹操一度议徙许都以避其锐。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (15–21 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: flood waters, boat; subject: Pang De, bow | Action: Yu Jin's seven armies are drowned; Pang De stands on the dike | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; layered dark and pale ink surging as a flood; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: roaring flood; SFX: arrow release | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「羽威震华夏」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「关羽威震华夏，曹操一度议徙许都以避其锐。」

narration: 建安二十四年，关羽率众攻曹仁于樊。曹操遣于禁助仁。
秋，大霖雨，汉水泛溢，于禁所督七军皆没。于禁降，庞德不屈而死。
关羽威震华夏，曹操一度议徙许都以避其锐。
孙权却派吕蒙袭取江陵。吕蒙把精兵藏在船中，使白衣摇橹，作商贾人服。南郡太守糜芳出降。
关羽回军，士卒离散——
十二月，孙权将马忠擒关羽及其子关平于章乡，斩之于临沮。荆州尽归东吴。
羽威震华夏

strings.scene.sanguo.yiling.title: 火烧连营
strings.scene.sanguo.yiling.subtitle: 夷陵之战
strings.vo.01: 关羽败亡之后，刘备称帝，起兵东征孙吴。
strings.vo.02: 孙权以陆逊为大都督。陆逊坚守不出，自春至夏，诸将多有怨言。
strings.vo.03: 蜀军自巫峡至夷陵，连营数十屯，时值盛夏，移营依林。
strings.vo.04: 陆逊说：今日方可破之。他令士卒各持一把茅草——
strings.scene.sanguo.yiling.fork.prompt: 火烧连营——依《三国志》直书，还是听演义「八阵图」？
strings.scene.sanguo.yiling.canon.intro: 刘备为关羽之死伐吴，连营数百里。陆逊坚守不战，从正月等到了六月。
strings.scene.sanguo.yiling.end.canon: 蜀军土崩，刘备退入白帝城。次年，刘备病逝于永安，托孤于诸葛亮。
strings.scene.sanguo.yiling.legend.disclaimer: 以下取自《三国演义》第八十四回，陆逊被困八阵图是小说情节。鱼复江边的八阵图石垒，北魏《水经注·江水》已有记载。
strings.scene.sanguo.yiling.legend.intro: 演义写陆逊追击至鱼腹浦，误入诸葛亮早年布下的乱石阵，风沙大作，不得出；幸得黄承彦引路而出。
strings.scene.sanguo.yiling.end.legend: 陆逊收兵东还。演义的插曲之后，故事汇回正史：刘备退守白帝。

第 1 行：1. 泼墨墨点飞溅；2. 飞白笔触；3. 爆裂墨团；4. 火星迸射。
第 2 行：5. 箭矢破空；6. 命中靶心墨点；7. 船行尾迹；8. 落石扬尘。
第 3 行：9. 火油烈焰；10. 火（过场笔画所绘）；11. 火烧连营（过场笔画所绘）；12. 留空。
排版参考尺寸：2048×1536 像素，每格按 512×512 切分；实际生成尺寸以所用服务返回值为准，裁切前须确认比例与透明通道。只有墨线与墨块，不加任何文字、书法、印章、边框、网格线、水印。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

sound.zh: 背景乐：战鼓与号角，雄壮，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、军营鼓声、林中蝉鸣、火声；音效：远处鼓声、低语、蝉鸣、烈火；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: war drums and horns, heroic, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, camp drums, cicadas, fire; SFX: distant drums, murmuring, cicada, roaring fire; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

孙权以陆逊为大都督。陆逊坚守不出，自春至夏，诸将多有怨言。

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

strings.scene.sanguo.menghuo.title: 七擒孟获
strings.scene.sanguo.menghuo.subtitle: 南中平定
strings.vo.01: 先主崩后，南中诸郡相继叛乱。建兴三年春，诸葛亮率众南征。
strings.vo.02: 马谡送行数十里，说：用兵之道，攻心为上，攻城为下；心战为上，兵战为下。
strings.vo.03: 诸葛亮采纳了。听说孟获素为夷汉所服，便下令要活捉他。
strings.vo.04: 擒住之后，使观营阵，问：此军何如？孟获说：向者不知虚实，故败。今蒙赐观看营阵，若只如此，即定易胜耳。
strings.vo.05: 诸葛亮笑了，放他回去再战——
strings.scene.sanguo.menghuo.quote: 公，天威也，南人不复反矣
strings.scene.sanguo.menghuo.fork.prompt: 七擒孟获——依《三国志》直书，还是听演义「七擒全过程」？
strings.scene.sanguo.menghuo.pick.canon: 正史注 · 《汉晋春秋》（裴注引）所载
strings.scene.sanguo.menghuo.canon.intro: 孟获被绑着带进营中，却被松了绑，领着看了一圈营阵。诸葛亮问他：此军何如？
strings.scene.sanguo.menghuo.end.canon: 南中平定。诸葛亮即用其渠帅，不留兵、不运粮，纲纪粗定，夷汉粗安。孟获后官至御史中丞。
strings.scene.sanguo.menghuo.legend.disclaimer: 以下按《三国演义》第八十七至九十回改编：正史只有“七纵七擒”一句，演义铺陈出七次擒纵的具体经过，以及木鹿大王驱兽、藤甲兵等情节，均为小说增饰。
strings.scene.sanguo.menghuo.legend.intro: 演义写七次擒纵，一次比一次奇：哑泉、毒泉，象兵猛兽，最后是火烧藤甲兵于盘蛇谷。
strings.scene.sanguo.menghuo.end.legend: 孟获第七次被擒，垂泪说：丞相天威，南人不复反矣。演义汇回史注。

背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：2×2 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。

第 1 行：1. 角弓与箭（弯弓与箭矢，弓弦紧绷）；2. 盾牌（圆盾，墨色包边，正面徽记）。
第 2 行：3. 留空；4. 留空。
