style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 三国 · 蜀汉建兴三年（225 年）。城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。
setting.en: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 225 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

characters.name: 诸葛亮
characters.zh: 诸葛亮（蜀·丞相）：袍服，幅巾或纶巾；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；南征四郡，攻心为上
characters.en: Zhuge Liang (诸葛亮) — minister, Shu; long robes, cloth headscarves; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 孟获
characters.zh: 孟获（南中·南中豪帅）：袍服，幅巾或纶巾；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；为夷汉所服，七纵七擒之后归心
characters.en: Meng Huo (孟获) — commoner, Nanzhong; long robes, cloth headscarves; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 马谡
characters.zh: 马谡（蜀·参军）：袍服，幅巾或纶巾；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；献“攻心为上”之策
characters.en: Ma Su (马谡) — minister, Shu; long robes, cloth headscarves; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

characters.name: 雍闿
characters.zh: 雍闿（南中·益州郡豪强）：袍服，幅巾或纶巾；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；黑色剪影造型，只保留冠帽、袖摆、兵器与甲片的大轮廓，头身比约 1:7，姿态一眼可读；起兵叛蜀，为高定部曲所杀
characters.en: Yong Kai (雍闿) — commoner, Nanzhong; long robes, cloth headscarves; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 先主崩后，南中诸郡相继叛乱。建兴三年春，诸葛亮率众南征。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山、云；中景：近山与地面、树、树冠｜动作：南中山林，瘴气弥漫｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；云气以淡墨晕染流动｜声音：环境：林中蝉鸣｜屏幕文字：片名「七擒孟获」竖排书法与朱印「七纵七擒」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「先主崩后，南中诸郡相继叛乱。建兴三年春，诸葛亮率众南征。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains, clouds; midground: near hills and ground, trees, tree canopy | Action: Miasma over the forests of Nanzhong | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; clouds as moving pale wash | Sound: ambience: cicadas | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「七擒孟获」 with vermilion seal 「七纵七擒」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「先主崩后，南中诸郡相继叛乱。建兴三年春，诸葛亮率众南征。」

shots.vo: 马谡送行数十里，说：用兵之道，攻心为上，攻城为下；心战为上，兵战为下。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（8–17 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：营帐；主体：马谡、诸葛亮｜动作：马谡送行：攻心为上｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白｜声音：环境：军营鼓声；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「马谡送行数十里，说：用兵之道，攻心为上，攻城为下；心战为上，兵战为下。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (8–17 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Ma Su, Zhuge Liang | Action: Ma Su sees him off: win their hearts | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「马谡送行数十里，说：用兵之道，攻心为上，攻城为下；心战为上，兵战为下。」

shots.vo: 诸葛亮采纳了。听说孟获素为夷汉所服，便下令要活捉他。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（17–25 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：河水、舟；主体：军阵、长兵如林｜动作：渡泸水，深入不毛｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：平缓河水；音效：摇橹｜屏幕文字：引文「公，天威也，南人不复反矣」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「诸葛亮采纳了。听说孟获素为夷汉所服，便下令要活捉他。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (17–25 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: river, boat; subject: army ranks, forest of spears | Action: Crossing the Lu River into the barren lands | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: oars | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「公，天威也，南人不复反矣」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「诸葛亮采纳了。听说孟获素为夷汉所服，便下令要活捉他。」

shots.vo: 擒住之后，使观营阵，问：此军何如？孟获说：向者不知虚实，故败。今蒙赐观看营阵，若只如此，即定易胜耳。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（25–36 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：营帐；主体：孟获、旌旗｜动作：孟获被擒，观营阵而还｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白｜声音：环境：军营鼓声；音效：远处鼓声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「擒住之后，使观营阵，问：此军何如？孟获说：向者不知虚实，故败。今蒙赐观看营阵，若只如此，即定易胜耳。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (25–36 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Meng Huo, banners | Action: Meng Huo is captured, shown the camp and released | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: distant drums | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「擒住之后，使观营阵，问：此军何如？孟获说：向者不知虚实，故败。今蒙赐观看营阵，若只如此，即定易胜耳。」

shots.vo: 诸葛亮笑了，放他回去再战——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（36–42 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：营帐；主体：孟获、诸葛亮；飞白题字「七擒」｜动作：第七次：公，天威也｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：众人呐喊；音效：急鼓｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「诸葛亮笑了，放他回去再战——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (36–42 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Meng Huo, Zhuge Liang; dry-brush calligraphy 「七擒」 | Action: The seventh time: you are Heaven's own might | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: roaring crowd; SFX: drum burst | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「诸葛亮笑了，放他回去再战——」

shots.vo: 南中平定。诸葛亮即用其渠帅，不留兵、不运粮，纲纪粗定，夷汉粗安。孟获后官至御史中丞。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（42–52 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：孟获、诸葛亮｜动作：正史结局：南中平定。诸葛亮即用其渠帅，不留兵、不运粮，纲纪粗定，夷汉粗安。孟获后官至御史中丞。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「南中平定。诸葛亮即用其渠帅，不留兵、不运粮，纲纪粗定，夷汉粗安。孟获后官至御史中丞。」

narration: 先主崩后，南中诸郡相继叛乱。建兴三年春，诸葛亮率众南征。
马谡送行数十里，说：用兵之道，攻心为上，攻城为下；心战为上，兵战为下。
诸葛亮采纳了。听说孟获素为夷汉所服，便下令要活捉他。
擒住之后，使观营阵，问：此军何如？孟获说：向者不知虚实，故败。今蒙赐观看营阵，若只如此，即定易胜耳。
诸葛亮笑了，放他回去再战——
南中平定。诸葛亮即用其渠帅，不留兵、不运粮，纲纪粗定，夷汉粗安。孟获后官至御史中丞。
公，天威也，南人不复反矣

strings.scene.sanguo.jieting.title: 街亭与空城
strings.scene.sanguo.jieting.subtitle: 马谡
strings.vo.01: 建兴六年春，诸葛亮出祁山，南安、天水、安定三郡叛魏应亮，关中响震。
strings.vo.02: 亮不用宿将魏延、吴懿，而以马谡督诸军在前，与张郃战于街亭。
strings.vo.03: 马谡违亮节度，举措烦扰，舍水上山。王平连连规谏，马谡不听。
strings.vo.04: 张郃断绝了他的汲水之道，击之，大破之。士卒离散。
strings.vo.05: 唯有王平所领千人，鸣鼓自持——
strings.scene.sanguo.jieting.fork.prompt: 街亭与空城——依《三国志》直书，还是听演义「空城计」？
strings.scene.sanguo.jieting.canon.intro: 街亭的山顶上，马谡指着山下的水源说：居高临下，势如破竹。王平又一次劝他。
strings.scene.sanguo.jieting.end.canon: 亮进无所据，拔西县千余家还汉中。戮马谡以谢众，上疏请自贬三等。
strings.scene.sanguo.jieting.legend.disclaimer: 以下按《三国演义》第九十五、九十六回改编。空城计源于裴注所引郭冲《条亮五事》，裴松之当时就指出：司马懿此时在宛城，此事不可信。
strings.scene.sanguo.jieting.legend.intro: 演义说：司马懿大军奔西城而来，城中只有二千五百军。诸葛亮大开城门，令军士扮作百姓洒扫，自己在城楼上焚香弹琴。
strings.scene.sanguo.jieting.end.legend: 魏军退去，诸葛亮回汉中，挥泪斩马谡。演义。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

shots.vo: 建兴六年春，诸葛亮出祁山，南安、天水、安定三郡叛魏应亮，关中响震。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：近山与地面、河水｜动作：陇右群山，街亭要道｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：高处疾风｜屏幕文字：片名「街亭与空城」竖排书法与朱印「挥泪斩马谡」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「建兴六年春，诸葛亮出祁山，南安、天水、安定三郡叛魏应亮，关中响震。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, river | Action: Mountains of Longyou and the vital road at Jieting | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: high wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「街亭与空城」 with vermilion seal 「挥泪斩马谡」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「建兴六年春，诸葛亮出祁山，南安、天水、安定三郡叛魏应亮，关中响震。」

shots.vo: 亮不用宿将魏延、吴懿，而以马谡督诸军在前，与张郃战于街亭。

shots.en: Shot 2 (8–16 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: near hills and ground, army tents; subject: Ma Su, Wang Ping | Action: Ma Su abandons the water and climbs the hill | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「亮不用宿将魏延、吴懿，而以马谡督诸军在前，与张郃战于街亭。」

shots.vo: 马谡违亮节度，举措烦扰，舍水上山。王平连连规谏，马谡不听。

shots.en: Shot 3 (16–24 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: river; subject: Zhang He, army ranks, forest of spears | Action: Zhang He cuts off their water supply | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: distant drums | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「戮谡以谢众」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「马谡违亮节度，举措烦扰，舍水上山。王平连连规谏，马谡不听。」

shots.vo: 张郃断绝了他的汲水之道，击之，大破之。士卒离散。

shots.en: Shot 4 (24–31 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Wang Ping, banners | Action: Wang Ping beats the drums and holds firm; Wei suspects an ambush | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: drum burst | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「张郃断绝了他的汲水之道，击之，大破之。士卒离散。」

shots.vo: 唯有王平所领千人，鸣鼓自持——

shots.en: Shot 5 (31–37 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Zhuge Liang; dry-brush calligraphy 「挥泪」 | Action: Ma Su is executed to answer to the army | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: drum burst | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「唯有王平所领千人，鸣鼓自持——」

shots.vo: 亮进无所据，拔西县千余家还汉中。戮马谡以谢众，上疏请自贬三等。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（37–45 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：诸葛亮｜动作：正史结局：亮进无所据，拔西县千余家还汉中。戮马谡以谢众，上疏请自贬三等。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「亮进无所据，拔西县千余家还汉中。戮马谡以谢众，上疏请自贬三等。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (37–45 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Zhuge Liang | Action: Canonical outcome: With no foothold, Zhuge Liang withdraws to Hanzhong, executes Ma Su and demotes himself three ranks. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「亮进无所据，拔西县千余家还汉中。戮马谡以谢众，上疏请自贬三等。」

shots.vo: 戮谡以谢众
shots.zh: 镜头 7（45–51 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「戮谡以谢众」，下署《三国志·蜀书·诸葛亮传》；右下角朱印「挥泪斩马谡」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「戮谡以谢众」
shots.en: Shot 7 (45–51 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「戮谡以谢众」 signed 《三国志·蜀书·诸葛亮传》; vermilion seal 「挥泪斩马谡」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「戮谡以谢众」

sound.zh: 背景乐：战鼓与号角，雄壮，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：高处疾风、旷野风声、远处厮杀声、寂静室内；音效：脚步声、远处鼓声、急鼓；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: war drums and horns, heroic, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: high wind, wind over open plains, distant battle, quiet room tone; SFX: footsteps, distant drums, drum burst; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 片头：右上竖排书法片名「街亭与空城」，副题「马谡」，朱印「挥泪斩马谡」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；引文：「戮谡以谢众」——《三国志·蜀书·诸葛亮传》，竖排楷书；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。
onScreenText.en: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「街亭与空城」, subtitle 「马谡」, vermilion seal 「挥泪斩马谡」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「戮谡以谢众」 — 《三国志·蜀书·诸葛亮传》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

narration: 建兴六年春，诸葛亮出祁山，南安、天水、安定三郡叛魏应亮，关中响震。
亮不用宿将魏延、吴懿，而以马谡督诸军在前，与张郃战于街亭。
马谡违亮节度，举措烦扰，舍水上山。王平连连规谏，马谡不听。
张郃断绝了他的汲水之道，击之，大破之。士卒离散。
唯有王平所领千人，鸣鼓自持——
亮进无所据，拔西县千余家还汉中。戮马谡以谢众，上疏请自贬三等。

风格：高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Three Kingdoms (220–280) · Jieting and the Empty City: Ma Su (「街亭与空城」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 51 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Setting: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 228 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

Characters:
- Ma Su (马谡) — minister, Shu; long robes, cloth headscarves; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zhuge Liang (诸葛亮) — minister, Shu; long robes, cloth headscarves; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Wang Ping (王平) — general, Shu; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Zhang He (张郃) — general, Wei; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Sima Yi (司马懿) — general, Wei; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, river | Action: Mountains of Longyou and the vital road at Jieting | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: high wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「街亭与空城」 with vermilion seal 「挥泪斩马谡」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「建兴六年春，诸葛亮出祁山，南安、天水、安定三郡叛魏应亮，关中响震。」
Shot 2 (8–16 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: near hills and ground, army tents; subject: Ma Su, Wang Ping | Action: Ma Su abandons the water and climbs the hill | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「亮不用宿将魏延、吴懿，而以马谡督诸军在前，与张郃战于街亭。」
Shot 3 (16–24 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: river; subject: Zhang He, army ranks, forest of spears | Action: Zhang He cuts off their water supply | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: distant drums | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「戮谡以谢众」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「马谡违亮节度，举措烦扰，舍水上山。王平连连规谏，马谡不听。」
Shot 4 (24–31 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Wang Ping, banners | Action: Wang Ping beats the drums and holds firm; Wei suspects an ambush | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: drum burst | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「张郃断绝了他的汲水之道，击之，大破之。士卒离散。」
Shot 5 (31–37 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Zhuge Liang; dry-brush calligraphy 「挥泪」 | Action: Ma Su is executed to answer to the army | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: drum burst | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「唯有王平所领千人，鸣鼓自持——」
Shot 6 (37–45 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Zhuge Liang | Action: Canonical outcome: With no foothold, Zhuge Liang withdraws to Hanzhong, executes Ma Su and demotes himself three ranks. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「亮进无所据，拔西县千余家还汉中。戮马谡以谢众，上疏请自贬三等。」
Shot 7 (45–51 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「戮谡以谢众」 signed 《三国志·蜀书·诸葛亮传》; vermilion seal 「挥泪斩马谡」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「戮谡以谢众」

Sound: Music: war drums and horns, heroic, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: high wind, wind over open plains, distant battle, quiet room tone; SFX: footsteps, distant drums, drum burst; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「街亭与空城」, subtitle 「马谡」, vermilion seal 「挥泪斩马谡」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「戮谡以谢众」 — 《三国志·蜀书·诸葛亮传》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, full colour, multicolour, pastel, candy colours, cute, chibi, big-head proportions, busy detailed textures, gradient-heavy CG, gold highlights, steampunk machinery, dense ruled-line detail, detailed faces, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes

strings.scene.sanguo.wuzhangyuan.title: 秋风五丈原
strings.scene.sanguo.wuzhangyuan.subtitle: 星落
strings.vo.01: 建兴十二年春，诸葛亮悉大众由斜谷出，以流马运粮，据武功五丈原，与司马懿对于渭南。
strings.vo.02: 亮常患粮不继，使己志不申，于是分兵屯田，为久驻之基。耕者杂于渭滨居民之间，而百姓安堵。
strings.vo.03: 相持百余日。亮数挑战，司马懿坚壁不出。
strings.vo.04: 其年八月，亮疾病，卒于军，时年五十四。
strings.scene.sanguo.wuzhangyuan.fork.prompt: 秋风五丈原——依《三国志》直书，还是听演义「禳星」？
strings.scene.sanguo.wuzhangyuan.pick.canon: 正史 · 《三国志》及裴注所载
strings.scene.sanguo.wuzhangyuan.canon.intro: 五丈原上，秋风吹进中军帐。诸葛亮在灯下批阅文书，罚二十以上，皆亲览焉。
strings.scene.sanguo.wuzhangyuan.end.canon: 司马懿退兵，不敢逼。百姓为之谚曰：死诸葛走生仲达。宣王闻之说：吾能料生，不便料死故也。他察看蜀军营垒处所，叹道：天下奇才也。
strings.scene.sanguo.wuzhangyuan.legend.disclaim: 以下按《三国演义》第一〇三、一〇四回改编：五丈原禳星、魏延踏灭主灯、木像退司马懿，都是小说情节。
strings.scene.sanguo.wuzhangyuan.legend.intro: 演义说：诸葛亮自知将死，在帐中设七星灯禳星，若七日主灯不灭，可延寿一纪。到了第六夜，魏延急报军情闯入帐中，踏灭了主灯。
strings.scene.sanguo.wuzhangyuan.end.legend: 主灯熄灭，将星坠落。演义汇回正史：五丈原的秋风。
strings.scene.sanguo.wuzhangyuan.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若诸葛亮多活十年（未开放）

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

setting.zh: 三国 · 蜀汉建兴十二年（234 年）。城池、水寨与楼船、军帐、江河。
setting.en: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 234 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

characters.en: Zhuge Liang (诸葛亮) — minister, Shu; long robes, cloth headscarves; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

shots.vo: 建兴十二年春，诸葛亮悉大众由斜谷出，以流马运粮，据武功五丈原，与司马懿对于渭南。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–10 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：河水、近山与地面｜动作：渭水之南，五丈原｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：旷野风声｜屏幕文字：片名「秋风五丈原」竖排书法与朱印「星落五丈原」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「建兴十二年春，诸葛亮悉大众由斜谷出，以流马运粮，据武功五丈原，与司马懿对于渭南。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: river, near hills and ground | Action: Wuzhang Plains south of the Wei River | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「秋风五丈原」 with vermilion seal 「星落五丈原」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「建兴十二年春，诸葛亮悉大众由斜谷出，以流马运粮，据武功五丈原，与司马懿对于渭南。」

shots.vo: 亮常患粮不继，使己志不申，于是分兵屯田，为久驻之基。耕者杂于渭滨居民之间，而百姓安堵。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（10–21 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：草、营帐；主体：众人｜动作：分兵屯田，耕者杂于渭滨居民之间｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白｜声音：环境：村落人声；音效：犁地｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「亮常患粮不继，使己志不申，于是分兵屯田，为久驻之基。耕者杂于渭滨居民之间，而百姓安堵。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (10–21 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: grass, army tents; subject: crowd | Action: Soldiers farm alongside the local people by the Wei | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white | Sound: ambience: village ambience; SFX: ploughing | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「亮常患粮不继，使己志不申，于是分兵屯田，为久驻之基。耕者杂于渭滨居民之间，而百姓安堵。」

shots.vo: 相持百余日。亮数挑战，司马懿坚壁不出。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（21–27 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：营帐、卷轴；主体：司马懿｜动作：送巾帼妇人之服，宣王不战｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白｜声音：环境：军营鼓声；音效：衣袂摩挲｜屏幕文字：引文「死诸葛走生仲达」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「相持百余日。亮数挑战，司马懿坚壁不出。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (21–27 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents, scroll; subject: Sima Yi | Action: Women's clothing is sent to Sima Yi, who refuses battle | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: rustling silk | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「死诸葛走生仲达」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「相持百余日。亮数挑战，司马懿坚壁不出。」

shots.vo: 其年八月，亮疾病，卒于军，时年五十四。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（27–33 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：远景：月、星；中景：营帐；主体：诸葛亮｜动作：秋夜，营中灯火｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；营帐三角黑块剪影，灯火留白；月轮留白，四周淡墨烘染｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：阵风｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「其年八月，亮疾病，卒于军，时年五十四。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (27–33 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: moon, stars; midground: army tents; subject: Zhuge Liang | Action: Autumn night, lamps in the camp | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; triangular black tent silhouettes with lamps left as paper white; moon left blank with pale wash around it | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: wind gust | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「其年八月，亮疾病，卒于军，时年五十四。」

shots.vo: 蜀军退去，司马懿追来——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（33–39 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：主体：旌旗、军阵、长兵如林；飞白题字「反旗」｜动作：反旗鸣鼓，若将向宣王｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；成排剪影由黑到灰逐层退远；枯笔竖线密如森林；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：号角｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「蜀军退去，司马懿追来——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (33–39 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: subject: banners, army ranks, forest of spears; dry-brush calligraphy 「反旗」 | Action: Banners turn and drums beat as if to attack Sima Yi | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; rows of silhouettes stepping back from black to grey; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: horn | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「蜀军退去，司马懿追来——」

shots.vo: 司马懿退兵，不敢逼。百姓为之谚曰：死诸葛走生仲达。宣王闻之说：吾能料生，不便料死故也。他察看蜀军营垒处所，叹道：天下奇才也。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（39–53 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：司马懿退兵，不敢逼。百姓为之谚曰：死诸葛走生仲达。宣王闻之说：吾能料生，不便料死故也。他察看蜀军营垒处所，叹道：天下奇才也。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「司马懿退兵，不敢逼。百姓为之谚曰：死诸葛走生仲达。宣王闻之说：吾能料生，不便料死故也。他察看蜀军营垒处所，叹道：天下奇才也。」

narration: 建兴十二年春，诸葛亮悉大众由斜谷出，以流马运粮，据武功五丈原，与司马懿对于渭南。
亮常患粮不继，使己志不申，于是分兵屯田，为久驻之基。耕者杂于渭滨居民之间，而百姓安堵。
相持百余日。亮数挑战，司马懿坚壁不出。
其年八月，亮疾病，卒于军，时年五十四。
蜀军退去，司马懿追来——
司马懿退兵，不敢逼。百姓为之谚曰：死诸葛走生仲达。宣王闻之说：吾能料生，不便料死故也。他察看蜀军营垒处所，叹道：天下奇才也。

strings.scene.sanguo.gaopingling.title: 高平陵之变
strings.scene.sanguo.gaopingling.subtitle: 三国归晋
strings.vo.01: 魏明帝死后，大将军曹爽与太傅司马懿共同辅政。曹爽专权，司马懿称病不出。
strings.vo.02: 正始十年正月，曹爽兄弟奉少帝曹芳出城，谒高平陵。
strings.vo.03: 司马懿立即关闭城门，占据武库，屯兵洛水浮桥，上表列曹爽之罪。
strings.vo.04: 桓范劝曹爽挟天子往许昌，号令四方。曹爽犹豫一夜——
strings.vo.05: 此后司马氏掌魏政。三十年后——
strings.scene.sanguo.gaopingling.fork.prompt: 高平陵之变——依《三国志》直书，还是听演义「司马懿诈病」？
strings.scene.sanguo.gaopingling.canon.intro: 司马懿称病，卧床不起。正始十年正月，曹爽兄弟随少帝出城谒高平陵。
strings.scene.sanguo.gaopingling.end.canon: 曹爽投降，旋被夷三族。263 年魏灭蜀，266 年司马炎代魏建晋，280 年晋灭吴，三国归于一统。
strings.scene.sanguo.gaopingling.legend.disclaim: 以下取自《三国演义》第一百六至一百七回，诈病情节本于《晋书》等史料，对话与细节为小说铺陈。
strings.scene.sanguo.gaopingling.legend.intro: 演义写李胜来辞行探病，司马懿佯装耳聋，故意把“荆州”听成“并州”，汤水流满衣襟。
strings.scene.sanguo.gaopingling.end.legend: 曹爽掷刀于地，说：我亦不失作富家翁。演义与正史同一结局。

style.zh: 高反差黑白红武侠水墨剪影风（类《影之刃》，简化版）：纸白或浅灰宣纸底，大块平涂、少纹理；人物为高反差黑色剪影，粗笔棱角边缘，枯笔飞白拖尾，面部几乎不画五官；背景只用三到四层灰阶平涂的远山、雾气、竹林与建筑剪影，大面积留白；横向侧视构图，武侠电影式的冷峻、肃杀与戏剧张力；动作以剪影姿态和运动拖影表达，命中或高潮时大块泼墨与朱红血雾喷溅；色板只用黑白红：墨黑 #141414、焦灰 #3a3a3a、中灰 #6e6e6c、淡灰 #a8a8a4、雾灰 #d2d1cc、纸白 #eceae4、朱砂红 #b3241c；朱砂红是唯一的强调色，只用于血、落日、旗帜与印章，单帧面积不超过一成。
style.en: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

narration: 魏明帝死后，大将军曹爽与太傅司马懿共同辅政。曹爽专权，司马懿称病不出。
正始十年正月，曹爽兄弟奉少帝曹芳出城，谒高平陵。
司马懿立即关闭城门，占据武库，屯兵洛水浮桥，上表列曹爽之罪。
桓范劝曹爽挟天子往许昌，号令四方。曹爽犹豫一夜——
此后司马氏掌魏政。三十年后——
曹爽投降，旋被夷三族。263 年魏灭蜀，266 年司马炎代魏建晋，280 年晋灭吴，三国归于一统。

镜头 5（31–37 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：舟；主体：降幡；飞白题字「三国归晋」｜动作：三十年后，石头城下降旗｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；大块泼墨炸开，朱红血雾斜向喷溅后定格｜声音：环境：平缓河水；音效：青铜钟声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「此后司马氏掌魏政。三十年后——」
镜头 6（37–48 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：曹爽投降，旋被夷三族。263 年魏灭蜀，266 年司马炎代魏建晋，280 年晋灭吴，三国归于一统。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「曹爽投降，旋被夷三族。263 年魏灭蜀，266 年司马炎代魏建晋，280 年晋灭吴，三国归于一统。」
镜头 7（48–54 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文；右下角朱印「高平陵」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处

声音：背景乐：战鼓与号角，雄壮，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：旷野风声、宫殿回响、平缓河水；音效：咳嗽、马蹄声、城门闭合、青铜钟声；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Three Kingdoms (220–280) · The Gaopingling Coup: the Three Kingdoms End in Jin (「高平陵之变」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 54 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: in the style of high-contrast black-white-red wuxia ink silhouette art (Shadow-Blade-like, simplified): paper-white or pale grey xuan ground, big flat shapes with minimal texture; characters as high-contrast black silhouettes with bold angular brush edges and dry-brush flying-white trails, almost no facial features; backgrounds limited to three or four flat grey layers of mountains, mist, bamboo and architecture in silhouette, with generous empty space; side-view wuxia staging, dark, cold and dramatic; action told through silhouette poses and motion trails, with big splash-ink and vermilion blood-spray accents only on hits or the climax; strict black-white-red palette: ink black #141414, charcoal grey #3a3a3a, mid grey #6e6e6c, pale grey #a8a8a4, fog grey #d2d1cc, paper white #eceae4, vermilion red #b3241c; vermilion is the only strong accent, used only for blood, sun, banners and seals, under 10% of any frame.

Setting: Three Kingdoms (220–280), 249 CE–280 CE — walled cities, river fortresses and tower ships, army tents, great rivers.

Characters:
- Sima Yi (司马懿) — minister, Wei; long robes, cloth headscarves; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Cao Shuang (曹爽) — royal / consort, Wei; long robes, cloth headscarves, tube-sleeved armour, ring-pommel swords and long halberds; noble prince's rich robes, jade pendants, formal cap and sash; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Jiang Ji (蒋济) — minister, Wei; long robes, cloth headscarves; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Cao Fang (曹芳) — ruler, Wei; long robes, cloth headscarves; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Huan Fan (桓范) — minister, Wei; long robes, cloth headscarves; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Sima Yan (司马炎) — ruler, Jin; long robes, cloth headscarves; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance
- Sun Hao (孙皓) — ruler, Wu; long robes, cloth headscarves; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; rendered as a black silhouette keeping only the big shapes of headgear, sleeves, weapon and armour plates, about 7 heads tall, pose readable at a glance

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–9 s, 9 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: crenellated city wall; dry-brush calligraphy 「雪」 | Action: Luoyang in the first month | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; scorched-ink outline of battlements; blank paper as snow, dry-brush flakes | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「高平陵之变」 with vermilion seal 「高平陵」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「魏明帝死后，大将军曹爽与太傅司马懿共同辅政。曹爽专权，司马懿称病不出。」
Shot 2 (9–16 s, 7 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Sima Yi | Action: The Grand Tutor lies ill, speaking confusedly | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; black pillar silhouettes slicing the frame, three grey layers of depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: cough | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「正始十年正月，曹爽兄弟奉少帝曹芳出城，谒高平陵。」
Shot 3 (16–24 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Cao Shuang, war horse, banners | Action: Cao Shuang escorts the emperor out to the tombs | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「司马懿立即关闭城门，占据武库，屯兵洛水浮桥，上表列曹爽之罪。」
Shot 4 (24–31 s, 7 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: midground: river; subject: Jiang Ji, shield wall | Action: The city gates close; the floating bridge over the Luo | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: gate slamming shut | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「桓范劝曹爽挟天子往许昌，号令四方。曹爽犹豫一夜——」
Shot 5 (31–37 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: boat; subject: 降幡; dry-brush calligraphy 「三国归晋」 | Action: Thirty years later surrender flags at Stone City | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; a big splash of ink bursts and a diagonal vermilion blood-spray hangs in a freeze-frame | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「此后司马氏掌魏政。三十年后——」
Shot 6 (37–48 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Cao Shuang surrenders and his clan is executed; Wei takes Shu, Jin replaces Wei, and Jin conquers Wu in 280. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「曹爽投降，旋被夷三族。263 年魏灭蜀，266 年司马炎代魏建晋，280 年晋灭吴，三国归于一统。」
Shot 7 (48–54 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「高平陵」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

Sound: Music: war drums and horns, heroic, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, palace hall reverb, calm river; SFX: cough, hoofbeats, gate slamming shut, bronze bell; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「高平陵之变」, subtitle 「三国归晋」, vermilion seal 「高平陵」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.
